jobs.title: Web Designer
jobs.description:
Web Designer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S Business Hours

About the Role

We’re looking for a skilled Web Designer to create polished, user-centered web experiences that balance visual quality with usability. You’ll translate briefs and product goals into wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes, ensuring designs are responsive, consistent, and ready for development.

Working closely with developers and stakeholders, you’ll own your designs from initial concept through implementation review. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented designer who takes pride in their work, communicates proactively, and can manage projects independently in a remote, asynchronous environment.

What You’ll Own

Visual Design & Prototyping

  • Translate project briefs and product goals into clear, user-centered web designs.
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes to communicate design concepts before development begins.
  • Balance visual appeal, usability, and business objectives across web experiences.

Responsive Web Design

  • Design and refine layouts for mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.
  • Apply responsive design principles to deliver consistent experiences across devices.
  • Consider how layouts and interactions translate into HTML and CSS.

Design System Maintenance

  • Contribute to and improve the existing design system.
  • Maintain consistency across components, typography, colors, spacing, and layouts.
  • Use component libraries and reusable design elements to support efficient workflows.

Developer Collaboration & Handoff

  • Work closely with front-end developers to ensure accurate design implementation.
  • Provide clear specifications, assets, and guidance for layouts and interactions.
  • Answer implementation questions and resolve design-related issues during development.

Feedback & Iteration

  • Incorporate stakeholder and user feedback into design revisions.
  • Refine designs efficiently while keeping the original project goals in focus.
  • Ask clarifying questions and communicate potential blockers early.

Design Quality Assurance

  • Review implemented pages against approved designs.
  • Identify visual inconsistencies, layout issues, and usability concerns.
  • Recommend fixes to maintain a high standard of design quality.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Professional experience in web design, supported by a portfolio demonstrating strong visual judgment, layout skills, and attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in a modern design tool such as Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD.
  • Experience with component libraries, reusable components, and auto-layout workflows.
  • Solid understanding of responsive design principles and how designs translate into HTML and CSS.
  • Familiarity with UX fundamentals, including information architecture, user flows, accessibility, and usability.
  • Strong written and spoken English for clear communication with distributed teams and stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines independently.
  • Strong attention to detail and willingness to refine work based on feedback.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take pride in producing polished, thoughtful design work and maintain high standards without constant supervision.
  • You communicate proactively, clarify requirements early, and keep collaborators informed.
  • You respond constructively to feedback and focus on delivering the best outcome for users and the business.
  • You work effectively in an asynchronous environment and manage your workload reliably.
  • You collaborate well with developers and understand the importance of accurate design handoffs.
  • You take ownership of your designs from concept through final implementation review.

What Success Looks Like

  • High-quality, user-centered web designs that align with project goals.
  • Responsive layouts that deliver consistent experiences across devices.
  • A well-maintained design system with reusable, consistent components.
  • Clear handoffs that help developers implement designs accurately.
  • Timely, thoughtful revisions based on feedback.
  • Implemented pages that closely match approved designs and meet quality expectations.

Typical Day

You’ll begin by reviewing feedback and comments on active design files and prioritizing your work. Depending on project needs, you may refine a landing page, develop a reusable design component, or revise a product interface.

You may also meet with a developer to discuss a design handoff or clarify an interaction. Later in the day, you’ll review completed work for quality, update project notes, and document progress so teammates across time zones can continue smoothly.

Interview Process

  • Initial Screening
  • Recruiter Interview
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

jobs.title: Recruiter
jobs.description:
Manufacturing is one of the most important industries in the world, yet much of the technology supporting it hasn't kept pace.

We're building a fundamentally different future for manufacturing software.

Fulcrum is evolving from a traditional manufacturing software company into an AI-native company. We're not interested in simply adding AI features to existing systems. We're rethinking how work gets done, building products that can take on increasingly complex work themselves and give manufacturers capabilities that weren't possible before.

That same thinking shapes how we work internally. We believe small teams of exceptional people, equipped with powerful tools and the freedom to make decisions, can accomplish extraordinary things.

We're looking for people who are naturally curious, take ownership, and aren't satisfied doing something a certain way just because that's how it's always been done. People who like figuring things out, building things, challenging assumptions, and continuously expanding what they're capable of.

There's a lot we're still figuring out, and that's part of the opportunity. If you're energized by meaningful problems, ambitious goals, and the chance to help build something genuinely different, you'll find plenty to do here.

About the Role

    We're looking for an experienced, resourceful Recruiter who knows how to find exceptional talent and has the judgment to recognize it.

    At Fulcrum, hiring isn't simply about filling open positions. Every person we bring onto the team has a meaningful impact on what we're capable of building, how quickly we move, and how we work together.

    You'll own full-cycle recruiting across a variety of roles, partnering closely with the Head of People and hiring managers to identify, attract, evaluate, and hire exceptional people.

    This is a hands-on role for someone who genuinely loves recruiting and takes pride in owning the entire process. One day you might be creatively sourcing hard-to-find talent or advising a hiring manager on a difficult decision; the next, you're coordinating interviews, managing logistics, or making sure a candidate has a great onsite experience. You understand that all of it matters.

    We're looking for someone who brings strong recruiting fundamentals, grit, and the initiative to figure things out without waiting for direction. You'll have support in learning Fulcrum, our hiring philosophy, and what makes someone successful here, but you'll bring the recruiting expertise.

    Over time, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of the recruiting function, helping shape how we attract, evaluate, and hire talent as the company grows.

What You'll Do

    Find and Hire Exceptional Talent

  • Own full-cycle recruiting across multiple functions, from initial sourcing through offer acceptance.
  • Develop creative sourcing strategies to identify, attract, and engage exceptional candidates, including passive talent.
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand their needs and define what exceptional performance looks like.
  • Conduct thoughtful, high-signal interviews that uncover how candidates think, solve problems, learn, and take initiative.
  • Look beyond resumes and traditional qualifications to recognize genuine ability, potential, and industriousness.
  • Make clear, evidence-based hiring recommendations and confidently challenge assumptions when necessary.

    • Own the Hiring Process and Candidate Experience

  • Manage the entire interview process, including scheduling, candidate communication, interview panels, onsite visits, and logistics.
  • Keep searches organized and moving forward, proactively identifying bottlenecks and solving problems.
  • Build strong relationships with candidates and deliver a thoughtful, professional experience at every stage.
  • Facilitate interview debriefs and help hiring managers make confident, informed decisions.
  • Partner with the Head of People and VP of Finance on compensation discussions and offers.
  • Support new hires through pre-start coordination, onboarding, and their first days at Fulcrum.
  • Jump into broader Operations team needs when necessary.

    • Continuously Improve How We Recruit

  • Use AI-powered sourcing platforms, research tools, and creative search strategies to uncover talent beyond traditional channels.
  • Leverage AI and automation to improve outreach, interview preparation, recruiting operations, and candidate engagement.
  • Experiment with new recruiting technologies and independently identify opportunities to work more effectively.
  • Track recruiting performance and use data to improve sourcing strategies, hiring processes, and outcomes.
  • Build scalable, efficient recruiting practices without introducing unnecessary complexity.

Who You Are

  • An experienced recruiter. You have strong recruiting fundamentals and know how to independently source, interview, evaluate, and close great candidates.
  • An exceptional judge of people. You look beyond polished answers and impressive resumes to understand how someone actually thinks, works, and approaches problems.
  • Industrious and self-directed. You don't wait for someone to tell you what needs to happen next. You identify opportunities, solve problems, and create momentum independently.
  • Gritty and resourceful. Difficult searches, rejection, and unexpected challenges don't discourage you. You're persistent, creative, and willing to try new approaches until you find a way forward.
  • Hands-on and detail-oriented. You take pride in every part of the recruiting process, from strategic sourcing to scheduling and coordination. You understand that the details matter.
  • Naturally curious. You ask thoughtful questions, dig beneath surface-level responses, and genuinely enjoy understanding people's motivations and capabilities.
  • Technically adventurous. You're comfortable using AI and modern recruiting technology, experimenting with new tools, and finding better ways to work.
  • Empathetic but discerning. You build trust quickly and treat people with care while maintaining the judgment to recognize misalignment and ask difficult questions.
  • Confident and collaborative. You can form an opinion, explain your reasoning, and respectfully challenge a hiring manager or leader when you see something differently.
    Adaptable and accountable. You're comfortable with ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and take ownership of outcomes without needing constant direction.

    Travel is required for this role.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with demonstrated success independently managing searches from sourcing through offers.
  • A strong track record of proactively identifying, attracting, and hiring exceptional talent across multiple functions.
  • Proven sourcing and interviewing skills, including the ability to assess candidates beyond traditional qualifications.
  • Experience partnering directly with hiring managers and influencing hiring decisions.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-powered sourcing tools, recruiting platforms, and technology to improve recruiting outcomes.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and candidate relationship management skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple searches and competing priorities independently.
  • Experience recruiting in a fast-moving technology company or startup is preferred.
  • Experience recruiting technical talent is a plus.
    We care more about your judgment, initiative, and demonstrated ability to find exceptional people than whether you've followed a traditional recruiting career path.

What Success Looks Like

  • You consistently identify and attract exceptional candidates who raise the bar for what Fulcrum can accomplish.
  • Hiring managers trust your judgment and see you as a genuine partner in making hiring decisions.
  • You independently manage searches from start to finish while delivering an excellent candidate experience.
  • You use AI, automation, and creative problem-solving to make recruiting more effective and efficient.
  • You proactively improve our hiring processes and take increasing ownership of the recruiting function, allowing the Head of People to focus on broader company priorities.

Compensation & Benefits

  • $90,000 - $120,000 base salary + equity
  • 401(k) matching after 90 days with immediate vesting
  • Health, dental, and vision benefits
  • Wellbeing benefits and perks
  • Unlimited vacation policy with required minimum vacation days
  • Cell phone and internet plan coverage

We're not here to make incremental improvements to the way things have always been done. We're here to rethink what's possible.

That takes people who are curious, ambitious, and excited to figure things out that haven't been figured out before.

If that sounds like you, we'd love to build with you.

ABOUT THE COMPANY: 

The company is dedicated to transforming lives through high-quality, person-centred care services across Australia. Spanning operations across our three group organisations, we deliver reliable, safe, and respectful support tailored to our participants' unique needs. We foster an accountable, results-driven culture where participant safety, dignity, choice, and compliance are paramount. 

ROLE OVERVIEW:

The Service Delivery and Operations Manager is an autonomous operational leadership role responsible for ensuring all three organisations operate efficiently, safely, professionally, and profitably every day. Reporting directly to the Managing Director, you will own staff performance, participant satisfaction, quality service delivery, NDIS compliance, rostering, and operational problem-solving without requiring day-to-day supervision.

In this role, you will lead the operations engine: resolving issues proactively, maintaining rigorous audit-ready standards, controlling labour costs, and partnering with sales and business development to smoothly onboard and support new participants.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. Rostering & Staff Coverage
  • Ensure 100% required support coverage for all scheduled participants, resolving cancellations, late arrivals, and absences immediately.
  • Conduct daily morning roster reviews to confirm staff deployment, appropriate worker-to-participant matching, and credential verification.
  • Manage after-hours and on-call escalation frameworks to maintain uninterrupted service continuity.
  • Optimize roster efficiency and control labour costs, overtime, and unapproved staffing expenses within budget.
2. Participant Care & Service Excellence
  • Safeguard person-centred, respectful, and safe service delivery in alignment with agreed participant support plans.
  • Acknowledge and resolve participant or family complaints within one business day (or immediately if urgent).
  • Maintain professional stakeholder communication with families, guardians, and Support Coordinators.
  • Coordinate closely with sales and Business Development Managers (BDMs) to assess operational capacity and ensure safe, seamless participant onboarding and commencement.
3. Team Leadership & People Management
  • Supervise, mentor, and direct Team Leaders and frontline support workers across all operational entities.
  • Oversee attendance, punctuality, and performance standards, addressing underperformance promptly and constructively.
  • Ensure comprehensive onboarding and induction for new support workers while identifying ongoing training and supervisory needs.
4. Quality, Governance & NDIS Compliance
  • Maintain full alignment with NDIS Practice Standards and ensure audit-ready documentation across all client records.
  • Ensure 100% compliance on staff screening, mandatory certifications, and worker credentials prior to shift deployment.
  • Review daily progress notes and medication administration records, ensuring documentation completion rates meet or exceed 98%.
  • Lead incident management workflows: identify, record, investigate, and escalate incidents, safeguarding concerns, and clinical risks immediately.
5. Operational Efficiency, Reporting & Financial Control
  • Deliver structured weekly operations performance reports to the Managing Director every Monday by 10:00 AM.
  • Chair weekly operations meetings with Team Leaders to review participant wellbeing, incidents, audits, and pipeline requirements.
  • Conduct monthly analyses of labour utilisation, gross margins, participant retention, and compliance trends.
  • Formulate and present monthly operational improvement plans to eliminate process waste, reduce overhead, and enhance profitability.

  • Experience: Minimum of 2 years of direct operational management experience within the Australian NDIS / Disability or Community Care sector.
  • NDIS Regulatory Knowledge: Thorough working knowledge of the NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission rules, NDIS Practice Standards, and mandatory reporting frameworks.
  • Workforce Management: Demonstrated track record managing high-volume rosters, shift-fill rates, and frontline care staff across distributed locations.
  • Compliance & Screening: In-depth understanding of Australian worker screening databases (NDIS Worker Screening Check, Working with Children Check, First Aid/CPR).
Preferred
  • Experience managing operations across multi-entity or federated organisational structures.
  • Familiarity with sector-specific care management and rostering software (e.g., ShiftCare, CareLink+, Deputy, Employment Hero).
  • Relevant tertiary qualifications in Business Administration, Healthcare Management, Human Services, or related disciplines.
  • Background collaborating with BDM/sales functions to align sales pipelines with operational onboarding capacity.
What You’ll Bring
  • Proactive Ownership: A self-starter mindset who identifies operational gaps, implements solutions, and delivers results without waiting for executive instruction.
  • Commercial Acumen: The ability to balance person-centred care with strict operational efficiency, budget targets, and labour cost management.
  • High Ethical Standards: Absolute refusal to compromise participant safety, dignity, choice, or regulatory compliance to meet financial targets.
  • Decisive Problem-Solving: Composure and agility when resolving daily emergencies, coverage shortages, and operational bottlenecks under pressure.
  • Clear Communication: Executive-ready verbal and written reporting skills suitable for direct liaison with executive leadership, participants, families, and regulatory bodies.

jobs.description:

URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/sx6tzFKwyUTPcquYzQkRFu/jobs-at-movement-labs

Movement Labs is an incubator and consulting firm that uses technology, data, and experimentation to stop fascism and build progressive power. We help progressives win and defeat MAGA extremists through year-round work grounded in research and real-world testing. Our team partners with leading advocacy groups, grassroots organizers, and electoral campaigns to develop innovative tactics, win elections, and shift power for the long term.

As the R&D powerhouse for the progressive movement, we’ve run over 100 randomized control trials (RCTs) on voter behavior and helped hundreds of organizations increase their impact. We work hard, and the environment evolves rapidly. We are adaptable, nimble, and shift quickly as needed to meet the moment. We are looking for candidates that thrive in this type of environment.

We are looking for 2 roles, Senior and Mid-level Data Engineers to join the Tech department. You will be a part of an 8-person data engineering team, and will have a lot of ownership and ability to make an impact. You’ll work cross-functionally in a collaborative, startup-like environment. 

What the work looks like for our data team: 

  • Design and implement scalable data architecture for targeting and engagement
  • Serve as technical partner to program teams
  • Extend our foundational datasets to facilitate new outreach strategies
  • Load-test our systems to prepare for elections 
  • Maintain key datasets for polling images and precinct cross-matching
  • Develop standardized experimental frameworks for testing campaign effectiveness
  • Build AI tooling that makes our own team faster — QC agents for data deliveries, the evals to trust them, and context systems that keep our repos self-documenting

Our data team’s work mixes greenfield builds, pragmatic plumbing, incident response, and operational work. The relative mix shifts with the political calendar.

This role is fully remote. This position has an initial term of six (6) months beginning on the employee's start date.

Responsibilities
  • Shape the pipelines and integrations feeding our RCT platform and our foundational voter datasets: the APIs, replication, federation layers, experiment randomization, and the failure modes that come with running data systems for hundreds of partner organizations on a non-negotiable political calendar
  • Extend our data platform and orchestration layer, and optimize it for cost, runtime, and reliability so it holds up during the elections, with millions of outreach attempts
  • Lead projects that span multiple systems and teams — scoping, designing, and driving them to real milestones
  • Hold the bar on quality — test and validate your own work, review teammates' code, and mentor through that review
  • Document and communicate — make your systems understandable to teammates, stakeholders, and non-engineers
  • Rotate through on-call and rapid response, including evenings and weekends during high-stakes moments like election cycles
  • Passionate about progressive politics and leveraging data, technology, organizing and research to build political power
  • 3-6+ years of experience (Senior or Mid-level) in designing, building, and operating production data pipelines and integrations
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python
  • Experience building production software across a modern data stack — cloud data warehouses (BigQuery or similar), a transformation framework like dbt, and an orchestrator like Dagster or Airflow
  • A track record of leading technical work across multiple systems or teams, and scoping ambiguous problems end-to-end
  • Sound judgment about when to refactor, when to ship pragmatically, and how to leave systems better than you found them
  • Strong written communication — you document what you build and can explain complex systems to non-engineers
  • Genuine commitment to the mission of stopping fascism and building progressive power, and comfort operating on a political calendar

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in the progressive, political, advocacy, or nonprofit sector — including awareness of c3/c4/PAC boundaries and the sensitivities of political and voter data
  • Familiarity with election results, voter file data, and the tools campaigns use to organize, text, and contact voters
  • Experience on Google Cloud Platform
  • Experience in on-call rotations and mentoring less-experienced engineers

We’re looking for candidates with a wide range of skills and experience. If you’re excited about the job, even if you don’t match all the characteristics, we encourage you to apply.

    • Base salary of $90,000-$150,000
    • Excellent health, dental, and vision benefits, 401(k) matching, and unlimited Paid Time Off
    • Remote first culture with teammates all around the country.
    • This position has an initial term of six (6) months beginning on the employee's start date. We love to keep top performers if possible.

Applications may be reviewed earlier on a rolling basis so it benefits candidates to apply as soon as possible. The application process includes a phone screen, an exercise, and a full interview with the hiring manager. Due to the nature of our work, the process is moving quickly, and we hope candidates will start as soon as possible. Applicants must be legally eligible to work in the United States. We are not able to provide sponsorship at this time.

Movement Labs is an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to economic and social justice. Women, people of color, LGBTQ people, people with disabilities, and members of other historically disenfranchised populations are strongly encouraged to apply. If you require accommodations as part of the hiring process, please contact careers@movementlabs.com.

Applications are reviewed by our hiring team—not automated systems. Our hiring process may include AI-assisted analysis of candidate materials, however, hiring decisions are made by human reviewers.

jobs.title: Creative Strategist (AI-Native, Direct Response)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: New York, New York, United States
URL: https://sweetspothvac.com/

About SweetSpot Heating & Cooling

SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here owns the function, works directly with the owner, and has a real path to leading the team as we scale.

About the role

We are hiring a creative strategist who will own paid ad creative end to end: research, angles, hooks, scripts, briefing creators and editors, and the learnings that turn winners into the next batch.

This is not a "make pretty ads" role and it is not strategy-only. You will direct really strong video editors and UGC creators, and you will use AI (including Claude Code) as your production engine for research, hooks, scripts and variants. We are honest about the level this role is hired at: we are looking for strong raw talent with real direct-response instincts who wants ownership and serious training, and who wants to grow into a top-tier strategist with us. You will get mentorship, a proven creative system, and weekly learnings reviews. In return we expect pace, curiosity, and work you can defend.

What you will do

  • Build the research base first: homeowner avatars, desires, objections, competitors, and our own ad account history. No angles before research.

  • Plan concepts in a structured roadmap, each with angle, avatar, desire, mechanism, authority, awareness level, emotion, positioning and urgency.

  • Write hooks and scripts built for the first 3 seconds: one desire, one avatar, one message per ad.

  • Brief UGC creators and editors so clearly they can execute with no follow-up call, and review their work to a finished, launch-ready ad.

  • Run the testing system: from one winning angle, build structured iterations where each variation tests something named.

  • Run the learnings: label every ad (Breakthrough, Spend Winner, KPI Winner, Loser), state why it performed, and turn that into the next round.

  • Hit 20 to 30 finished, launch-ready ads per month at full pace, working with our editors and AI workflows.

What we are looking for

  • Direct-response ad experience: you have written ads that ran as paid social (Meta or TikTok) and you can show them.

  • A testing system, not just good taste. You can explain how you turn one winner into 20 variations.

  • Research discipline. Your hooks trace to evidence, not guesses.

  • AI fluency: you already use AI tools in your creative workflow and can show how.

  • Execution: you have briefed creators or managed editors and shipped finished ads.

  • Ownership mindset: you talk about business outcomes, not just outputs delivered, and you close feedback loops: you learn, you apply, you show what changed.

  • Local services or lead generation experience is a plus, not a requirement. Seasonal urgency, emergency calls, proof and trust are the game here.

Pay and structure

  • Contract (1099), remote, month-to-month: $4,000 to $8,000 per month, 40 hours per week, based on experience.

  • Performance bonus structure discussed after the trial month, tied to winning ads.

  • Growth path: this seat grows into leading the creative team. One of the paths we model is editor or strategist to team lead as spend scales.

Our hiring process (exactly how it works)

  1. Short application: portfolio of ads you wrote that actually ran, plus 3 short answers (your testing system on a real winner; one ad you iterated and what it tested; your AI workflow).

  2. Interview 1 (30 minutes): screening and craft in one call, run as a working session on your past ads: what did you learn, how did you apply it, what feedback loops did you complete.

  3. Paid test: $100 flat, 48 hours, capped at 4 hours of work, paid regardless of outcome. A short research snapshot, hooks, scripts, an iteration plan and an execution plan for a real scenario.

  4. Interview 2 (final, with the owner): we walk your test together and you defend your choices. References are checked after this call (we will ask to speak with one past employer). Two interviews total, no more.

  5. Paid 30-day trial at your full agreed monthly rate, with daily contact, mentorship and a weekly check-in. Written decision at day 30.

We hire off the test and the trial, not the interview. If you are the kind of strategist who would rather prove it than pitch it, apply.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sweetspot-heating-and-cooling-creative-strategist-ai-native-direct-response

jobs.title: Product Manager, Aperture
jobs.description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We are seeking a talented and motivated full-time Product Manager, Aperture to help shape the product strategy for Tailscale's AI gateway. Aperture gives organizations visibility and control over how their teams use AI. It routes and secures LLM traffic through Tailscale's identity layer instead of distributing API keys, so security and platform teams can see who's using which models, enforce usage policy, and eliminate key sprawl.

You'll be the first dedicated PM on this team, working directly with our co-founder and working alongside a small, AI-native engineering team to take Aperture from its current early-stage footing into a core part of how Tailscale's customers adopt AI safely. This is a foundational role: you'll bring product rigor and customer focus to a team that's moved fast and proven real demand, and you'll have outsized influence over what Aperture becomes as it matures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Shape Aperture's product roadmap, in close partnership with our co-founder, Engineering Manager and the engineering team, translating a fast-moving, still-forming product area into clear priorities.
  • Work directly with reference/design-partner customers to translate their AI governance and security needs into concrete product requirements.
  • Partner with engineering to balance rapid prototyping with the production rigor required for an AI product customers depend on during their daily work.
  • Represent Aperture externally — to customers, partners, and the community — as a credible voice on AI governance and enterprise AI adoption.
  • Track and report on adoption, usage, and the metrics that matter for a product still establishing product-market fit.
  • Partner with GTM and Customer Success as Aperture moves toward defined pricing and a repeatable sales motion.

What We Are Looking For

  • 3-5 years of product management experience (can include experience in other technical customer facing roles, e.g. SE or FDE), including meaningful time in an early-stage or 0-to-1 product context
  • Comfort with ambiguity and fast, shifting priorities — this is a small team still defining its own scope.
  • Experience building products for technical buyers (IT, security, or platform teams), since Aperture's customers are CISOs, platform engineers, and IT admins.
  • Strong technical fluency — able to work credibly with engineers building in Go and go deep on identity, security, and AI-agent workflows.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to represent the product externally.

Nice to Have

  • Prior product experience in AI/LLM infrastructure, developer tools, or identity/security products.
  • Familiarity with the AI gateway landscape (e.g., LiteLLM, Portkey, Kong AI Gateway, Cloudflare AI Gateway) and how Aperture's identity-based approach differs.
  • Experience partnering with GTM to bring a nascent product category to a defined pricing and sales motion.
  • Public technical writing, conference talks, or community engagement.
  • Hands-on experience with Tailscale, at work or at home.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

CAN Pay Range
$209,040—$296,140 CAD

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

jobs.title: Bookkeeper
jobs.description:
Position Type: Full-Time | Remote

Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We’re looking for a detail-oriented and dependable Bookkeeper to maintain accurate financial records and support day-to-day accounting operations. You’ll manage transaction recording, accounts payable and receivable, bank reconciliations, expense tracking, and financial reporting to ensure records remain accurate, organized, and up to date.

The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of bookkeeping fundamentals, experience with accounting software, and the ability to work independently while communicating proactively with the finance team.

Key Responsibilities

Transaction Recording & General Ledger

  • Record daily financial transactions accurately across accounts.
  • Maintain a clean, current, and well-organized general ledger.
  • Ensure transactions are coded and posted to the correct accounts.
  • Review entries for accuracy and flag discrepancies promptly.

Accounts Payable & Receivable

  • Process incoming and outgoing payments accurately and on time.
  • Track outstanding invoices and follow up on overdue payments.
  • Maintain accurate accounts payable and receivable records.
  • Prepare and update aging reports for the finance team.

Bank & Account Reconciliation

  • Perform regular reconciliations across bank accounts and credit lines.
  • Identify, investigate, and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner.
  • Ensure account balances and supporting records are accurate.

Financial Reporting & Expense Tracking

  • Prepare monthly and periodic financial summaries, including balance sheets and profit-and-loss statements.
  • Monitor, categorize, and record business expenses.
  • Identify unusual transactions or expense discrepancies and flag them for review.
  • Maintain accurate financial data to support business decisions.

Compliance & Documentation

  • Maintain organized, complete, and audit-ready financial records.
  • Prepare supporting documentation for audits, tax filings, and compliance activities.
  • Follow established accounting procedures and documentation standards.
  • Support the finance team with additional bookkeeping tasks as needed.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or a related accounting role.
  • Strong understanding of double-entry accounting, reconciliations, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and basic financial reporting.
  • Proficiency with at least one accounting platform, such as QuickBooks, Xero, Tally, or an equivalent tool.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for reporting and financial data management.
  • High attention to detail and a methodical approach to data entry and record-keeping.
  • Ability to identify discrepancies and maintain accurate financial records with minimal errors.
  • Professional written English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and coordinate effectively with a finance team across time zones.

Perfect Fit / Culture

You’ll thrive in this role if you take ownership of financial accuracy, follow established processes consistently, and flag discrepancies before they become larger issues. You should be organized, dependable, and proactive in communicating progress, questions, and potential blockers.

The ideal candidate is comfortable managing bookkeeping responsibilities independently while maintaining clear communication with the finance team and meeting reporting deadlines.

Typical Day

  • Review and record new financial transactions.
  • Code transactions and post entries to the appropriate accounts.
  • Reconcile bank accounts and credit lines.
  • Process payments and follow up on outstanding invoices.
  • Review and categorize expenses and investigate discrepancies.
  • Prepare financial summaries and update reports.
  • Organize supporting documents and communicate any issues requiring review.

Interview Process

  1. AI Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Offer Stage

Apply here:

THE ROLE

We are hiring expert Persian transcribers to convert audio recordings of native speakers into precise, conventionally formatted written transcripts. The work powers speech recognition, dialogue, and evaluation systems for major AI labs. Audio ranges from clean studio recordings to natural conversational speech in real-world acoustic conditions.

You will be working at the level of expert linguistic judgment. This is not data entry. Decisions about orthography, code-switching, speaker attribution, disfluencies, and non-speech events shape the quality of every model trained on your output.

DIALECT AND SCOPE

Persian (Farsi) as spoken in Iran, with awareness of related Dari (Afghanistan) and Tajik varieties where they appear. Project audio reflects everyday Iranian Persian speech with regional variation.

Primary speaker regions: Tehran, Isfahan, Mashhad, Shiraz, Tabriz, Qom.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Transcribe audio recordings into accurate, time-aligned written text following Perle's project-specific style guide
  • Apply correct conventions for speaker identification, overlapping speech, disfluencies, fillers, false starts, and non-speech events such as laughter, background noise, and music
  • Make principled orthographic decisions for dialectal, colloquial, and code-switched speech
  • Flag ambiguous segments, uncertain speakers, and audio quality issues using project conventions
  • Self-review every submission against Perle's quality bar before delivery
  • Engage with QA reviewers on edge cases, calibration sessions, and style guide updates

MUST HAVE

  • Native fluency in Iranian Persian with lifelong residence or deep immersion in Iran
  • High accuracy reading and writing in Perso-Arabic script
  • Ability to distinguish Iranian Persian from Dari and Tajik in mixed audio
  • Familiarity with Arabic loanword conventions and Persian colloquial speech
  • At least two years of professional transcription, captioning, court reporting, broadcast, translation, or linguistic annotation experience
  • Demonstrated accuracy at the word level under deadline pressure
  • Comfortable with web-based annotation platforms and variable-speed audio playback
  • Reliable high-speed internet, quality headphones, and a quiet workspace
  • Ability to commit to defined volume per week during active project phases

NICE TO HAVE

  • Background in Iranian linguistics, translation, journalism, or media
  • Prior experience annotating Persian-variety speech data
  • Working knowledge of Arabic, Dari, or Tajik for cross-lingual audio
  • Familiarity with IPA or other phonetic transcription systems
  • Experience with verbatim versus clean-verbatim transcription conventions

HOW WE WORK WITH YOU

  • Per-task or per-minute compensation, with rates tied to audio complexity and turnaround
  • Flexible scheduling, with volume scaling up and down based on active client projects
  • Direct working relationship with Perle's linguistic leads and QA team
  • Eligible for invitation to additional Perle expert projects across related domains

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About AlphaSense:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Team:

Our diverse Product & Engineering team values innovation, collaboration, and the continuous improvement of our platform. We offer a dynamic work environment where employees can grow and thrive while working on cutting-edge technology that shapes the future of AI and search.

At AlphaSense, we believe that diverse experiences and perspectives are critical to our success. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Principal Engineer to lead the design, evolution, and reliability of our global financial data extraction and normalization platform. This system ingests filings across formats (HTML, PDF, APIs, spreadsheets), extracts and standardizes financial data using a combination of AI and deterministic systems, and delivers trusted, traceable outputs at scale to downstream financial services teams and customers.

This role owns the self-sourcing and extraction foundation used by multiple teams across the organization. Today, human validation is used as a safety net. Your mission is to systematically reduce human dependency by increasing system correctness, confidence, and trust, without sacrificing speed or scalability.

You will operate at the intersection of distributed systems, AI-driven extraction, data quality, and platform architecture, raising the technical bar and reshaping how we build reliable systems.

Who You Are:

  • 15+ years of experience building and operating large-scale production systems
  • Proven experience designing data ingestion, extraction, or processing systems at scale
  • Deep expertise in one or more of:
    • Distributed systems
    • Data platforms and pipelines
    • AI/ML-powered extraction or classification systems
    • Platform or infrastructure engineering
  • Demonstrated ability to design trustworthy systems that combine probabilistic (AI) and deterministic approaches
  • Strong understanding of system reliability, observability, failure modes, and iterative hardening
  • Experience reducing operational or human overhead through better system design
  • Track record of technical leadership across teams without formal people management
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving clarity where none exists
  • Passion for using AI responsibly and effectively to deliver scalable, high-confidence systems
  • Nice to Have
    • Experience with document understanding, NLP, or financial data extraction
    • Experience building provenance, lineage, or confidence-scoring systems
    • Familiarity with cloud-native architectures and modern data stacks
    • Experience shaping or owning internal platforms used by multiple teams

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the architecture and evolution of our large-scale data extraction and normalization platform
  • Design systems that process hundreds of thousands of records across heterogeneous sources (PDF, HTML, APIs, XLS) with high reliability
  • Define and implement strategies to minimize human-in-the-loop validation through AI-based validation, confidence scoring, provenance tracking, and deterministic safeguards
  • Establish clear system contracts for correctness, traceability, and confidence (e.g., “where did this number come from?”)
  • Balance AI-driven approaches with procedural and rules-based systems where they improve reliability and explainabilityIdentify and remediate architectural and operational bottlenecks impacting scale, accuracy, and developer velocity
  • Act as the technical authority to block poor designs, redesign critical systems, and introduce new platforms or tooling when necessary
  • Partner with product and downstream consumers to define quality bars, SLAs, and success metrics
  • Serve as a technical escalation point for production issues, reliability failures, and systemic risks
  • Mentor senior engineers, shape technical culture, and raise expectations for system design and execution
  • Contribute to long-term technical strategy while remaining hands-on with critical implementations

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

You may also be offered equity, and a generous benefits program.

Compensation Range
$246,000—$339,000 USD

All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @ email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

jobs.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

This is an opportunity to shape the future of cloud networking user experience at Canonical, the company behind Ubuntu. We're looking for an exceptional Staff Design Engineer who can make complex networking infrastructure intuitive, powerful, and delightful for developers and operations teams working in cloud environments.

As a Staff Design Engineer, you'll define the UX vision for how users interact with networking across our cloud portfolio—from MAAS to MicroCloud and Ubuntu Server networking. You'll work on challenges like visualizing network topologies, designing intuitive configuration interfaces, and creating experiences that make infrastructure manageable at scale.

This role sits in the design team reporting to the Infrastructure design manager and is expected to have a company-wide impact.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region.

The role entails

  • Defining and driving the UX strategy for cloud networking products across Canonical's portfolio
  • Designing intuitive interfaces for highly complex networking concepts that rethink VPCs, subnets, routing tables, security groups, load balancers, and network observability
  • Creating and evolving design systems and patterns that scale across multiple products and platforms
  • Conducting user research with DevOps engineers, network administrators, SREs, and cloud architects to understand their workflows, pain points, and mental models
  • Building prototypes and high-fidelity designs using Figma or similar tools
  • Creating experiences for network troubleshooting, monitoring, and observability
  • Working on both GUI and terminal-based user experiences, understanding that our users span from UI to CLI preferences
  • Mentoring designers and contribute to design culture across Canonical
  • Owning one of our working groups to enable Canonical design’s horizontal efforts


What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Bachelor’s or equivalent in User Experience, Design, or STEM or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • 8+ years of experience in product design, UX design, or interaction design, with a strong portfolio of B2B/enterprise products
  • Solid understanding of cloud computing and networking fundamentals, experience designing for developers and operations teams, and their workflows
  • Strong information architecture skills and can organize complex systems into clear, navigable structures
  • Experienced in user research methodologies and can translate findings into actionable design decisions
  • Excellent communication skills and can articulate design rationale to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working in a distributed, remote-first environment
  • Knowledge and passion for the intersection of user experience, technology and design
  • Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific
  • Result-oriented with a drive to finish work and celebrate success
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits below, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Who We Are

Scratch Financial (“Scratch”) is a late stage venture-backed financial technology business based in Pasadena, California. At Scratch, everything starts and ends with our mission: being the payment partner of choice for veterinary practices and helping pet parents access the care their animals need without financial barriers. Driven by our award-winning technology, Scratch has become the fastest growing financing provider in veterinary care, with a partner network of 15,000+ practices across the U.S. and Canada.

Scratch has 2 main products:

  • Scratch Pay: Point-of-sale client facing lending, including a BNPL offering and longer-term payment plans
  • Scratch Checkout: Payment processing that is integrated with the veterinary practice management software

We are a company built on the foundation of transforming the way pet healthcare payments are done, and we are looking for innovators who share our commitment to shaping the future of veterinary care financing. If putting compassion first, helping tell the story of groundbreaking products and continuously learning & refining to achieve exceptional outcomes sounds like you, then we encourage you to apply.

Position Overview

In the four years since launching, payment processing has evolved from our first customer to serving many of the industry’s largest, most sophisticated and most demanding hospital networks. With Scratch now providing payment services to thousands of enterprise locations, we are looking for a leader to share the benefit of Scratch across new partners, and to provide consultative services to our current partner as they look to maximize the benefit of our technology.

The Director of Strategic Partnerships will be responsible for driving enterprise-level revenue growth across Scratch’s ecosystem. This role focuses on expanding adoption of Scratch Checkout within our existing Scratch Pay provider base, unlocking new enterprise partnerships, and leading the sales and go-to-market motion for emerging initiatives such as Scratch Rebates. You will develop and manage deep relationships with large veterinary groups, providing consultative partnership through the sales cycle, cross-functional implementations, and internal advocacy as those relationships scale.

This role is ideal for someone who is equally comfortable hunting for new enterprise opportunities, nurturing complex relationships, influencing executives, and mobilizing internal teams to deliver value for customers.

What You'll Do

  • Enterprise Sales & Revenue Growth
    • Own the end-to-end enterprise sales cycle for Scratch Checkout and future strategic products, from lead generation to negotiation and close.
    • Deepen adoption across large existing Scratch Pay partners through consultative, data-driven selling.
  • Strategic Account Management
    • Build and manage executive-level relationships within high-value accounts, serving as a trusted advisor on strategic and operational initiatives.
    • Conduct business reviews, performance analyses, and ROI discussions to secure expansion and retention
  • New Initiative Commercialization (e.g., Rebates)
    • Act as the commercial leader for new strategic initiatives like Scratch Rebates, driving early partner adoption, gathering feedback, and shaping product-market fit.
    • Partner with Product to influence feature development and ensure initiatives align with enterprise customer needs.
    • Build sales enablement materials, pricing frameworks, and scalable go-to-market strategies for new offerings.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7–10+ years of enterprise sales or strategic account management experience in tech (e.g., fintech, payments, SaaS), with a strong preference for candidates who have sold into veterinary corporate groups.
  • Proven track record of exceeding revenue targets and driving growth within long, complex sales cycles.
  • Deep experience selling into multi-location or enterprise organizations, with the ability to navigate matrixed structures and multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Strong executive presence, with demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders, negotiate strategic agreements, and drive alignment across functions.
  • Expertise in consultative, data-driven selling, including conducting ROI analyses, performance reviews, and strategic business discussions that drive towards mutually aligned KPIs.
  • Experience managing large, high-value accounts, building long-term relationships, and driving expansion within existing customers.

Why You'll Love Working Here

Customer Success Manager (Ireland - Remote)

Your AI strategy is only as strong as the data behind it. Quest Software builds the foundation for enterprise AI with solutions in data governance, cybersecurity, and platform modernization. More than 45,000 companies — including 90% of the Fortune 500 — trust Quest to solve their most critical challenges. The Customer Success Organization focuses on our most strategic customers. As a Strategic Customer Success Manager at Quest, you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring these customers realize maximum value from their investments through comprehensive adoption and value engagements. The CSM will manage a portfolio of accounts and lead engagement throughout the customer lifecycle—from deployment and adoption through value realization and renewal—ensuring satisfaction and long-term success.

You’ll leverage your expertise to guide customers through their journey, maintain consistent engagement, and ensure they achieve their goals and derive measurable value from Quest solutions. You’ll also surface Customer Success Qualified Leads (CSQLs) and coordinate with Account Management for follow-up. CSMs support renewal contracting processes and are expected to stay informed on Quest’s evolving product portfolio, demonstrating the ability to quickly learn and communicate the value of new offerings.

Above all, this role is accountable for retention—sustaining business growth and profitability by maximizing value, driving usage and adoption, supporting services, and reducing churn.

Responsibilities

  • Owns the customer relationship of a global or large-scale strategic account and actively manages the stakeholder relationship at all levels (i.e., executive, management, technical leaders) including strategic roadmap discussions
  • Develops and nurtures relationships and adjusts value and adoption messaging according to the levels and interests of customer stakeholders
  • Coaches peers on strategic approaches, provide mentorship for Enterprise CSMs to help them grow their knowledge and provide premium customer experience
  • Identifies and creates solutions to address Customer Success needs, improve effectiveness and efficiency, and delivery to or exceed key customer metrics.
  • Develops and maintains strategic Success Plans that align to value milestones and customer-defined business outcomes.
  • Partners with the customer to build a joint plan for success, maintaining a detailed understanding of the customer’s business to achieve high levels of customer satisfaction, engagement, and adoption of Quest technologies.
  • Monitors customer analytics and KPIs to reinforce the value of the customer solution, identify areas to improve customer experience, and optimize the solution.
  • Facilitates Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) in collaboration with Account Management, using the Success Plan and business case to demonstrate impact, value delivered, and opportunities for growth.
  • Delivers an outstanding customer experience to support our brand promise of delivering superior outcomes and to support and identify cross-sell and upsell of services and products.
  • Actively monitors customer engagement signals and sentiment; log risks and opportunities in CRM and trigger internal playbooks where applicable.
  • Supports collaboration across Sales, Support, Product, Renewals, and Professional Services to ensure continuity and strategic alignment.
  • Acts as an escalation point for high-impact customer issues when necessary, ensuring appropriate teams within Quest are engaged for quick resolution.
  • Works within the wider CSM team to implement scalable programs and process improvements to drive efficiency of internal customer success processes and improve customer experience.

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (or equivalent experience)
  • Minimum of 6 years of experience in customer success, technical account management, sales engineering, or similar role responsible for driving customer success and product/service adoption.
  • Minimum of 6 years of experience in customer management within platform management and security solutions, focusing on growth, adoption, retention, and issue resolution at both the business owner and senior executive levels.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into business value, and work with sales and marketing to promote value-driven solutions
  • Ability to manage executive relationships and discussions (VP/CxO)
  • Skilled in bringing in a SAE/AE/ISR to see through upsell opportunities, whilst maintaining executive overlay and ensuring a positive customer experience
  • Strong knowledge of Customer Success best practices, with experience in defining process and providing enablement programs to promote adoption in CS and across the company
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to establish milestones and keep success plans on task.
  • Adept at handling internal and external escalations.
  • Exceptional ability to communicate and foster positive business relationships, and comfortable facilitating change and being accountable for driving success with customers.
  • Experience in leading, adopting and driving change internally or externally.
  • Experience in identifying, translating and prioritizing customer issues and needs into business or solution requirements.
  • Demonstrated success as a trusted advisor to senior executives in large organizations and ability to build success plans.
  • An understanding of how organizations measure value realization and drive revenue. Experience in recurring revenue sales models and renewal processes is an advantage.
  • Fluency in English and German.

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • Experience in transformational Customer Success projects or experience where products shift from On-Premise to SaaS.
  • Previous Customer Success experience in a company with B2B Software.
  • Proficiency in customer success tools (e.g., Gainsight, Totango) and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) to manage customer health, success plans, and engagement tracking. Experience with AI prompting and leveraging AI tools to streamline processes.
  • Fluency in Dutch would be an advantage.

Department: Accounts Receivable / Finance

Build Your Career With Alia Services

Alia Services connects talented professionals with growing companies around the world. We specialize in remote recruitment, workforce, and payroll solutions, helping organizations build exceptional teams while creating meaningful career opportunities for professionals.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Accounts Receivable Representative (AR Representative III) who is ready to take ownership of complex accounts, drive collections performance, and become a trusted resource within the AR team.

If you have strong B2B accounts receivable and collections experience, enjoy solving complex payment issues, and are comfortable communicating directly with customers and internal stakeholders, this could be a great next step in your career.

Why Join Alia Services?

At Alia Services, we want our team members to feel supported throughout their employment while having opportunities to grow professionally. As part of our team, you'll have access to:

  • 100% Remote Work – Work from the comfort of your home while collaborating with an international team and client.
  • Health Insurance – Health insurance coverage provided through SafetyWing, beginning as soon as you are hired.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) – Enjoy paid time off to rest, recharge, and maintain a healthy work-life balance.
  • Reliable Payroll – Consistent payroll administration and support from the Alia Services team.
  • Dedicated HR Support – Access to our People Operations team for employment-related questions, support, and guidance throughout your time with us.
  • Professional Growth – Opportunities to develop your skills, gain international experience, and grow professionally.
  • Coaching & Feedback – One-on-one coaching, ongoing feedback, mentorship, and development opportunities.
  • International Experience – Gain valuable experience working remotely with international companies and teams.
  • Cross-Functional Development – Opportunities to expand your knowledge and gain exposure to different areas of the business.
  • Equipment Coordination – Equipment support and coordination may be available depending on the position and client requirements.
  • Ongoing Employee Support – From onboarding through your day-to-day employment, Alia Services serves as your dedicated partner throughout your experience with the client.

With Alia Services, you're not just being placed in a remote role we remain part of your employment journey, providing ongoing HR, payroll, benefits, and professional support while you grow in your career.

About the Role

As a Senior Accounts Receivable Representative, you will play an important role in maintaining the financial health of the organization by managing customer accounts, resolving outstanding balances, and ensuring timely and accurate collections.

This is more than a transactional AR position. You'll independently manage accounts and escalations, communicate directly with customers regarding aged receivables, collaborate with teams across the organization, and serve as a knowledgeable resource for other members of the AR team.

Success in this role requires a combination of strong collections experience, attention to detail, customer communication, problem-solving, and ownership.

What You'll Do

Accounts Receivable & Collections

  • Manage a portfolio of customer accounts and proactively follow up on past-due invoices via phone and email
  • Independently manage aged receivables and customer-level escalations
  • Lead customer conversations regarding outstanding balances and payment resolution
  • Maintain account aging in accordance with established KPIs and productivity expectations
  • Research and resolve short payments, overpayments, returned payments, and other account discrepancies
  • Support payment research and credit validation activities
  • Determine appropriate small-balance and month-end write-offs in accordance with established procedures
  • Make recommendations to leadership regarding the collection of significantly past-due accounts
  • Maintain accurate and detailed account and invoice notes

Customer & Cross-Functional Support

  • Partner with Sales, Account Executives, Customer Service, and Finance to resolve AR-related concerns
  • Provide customers with invoice copies, statements, payment confirmations, and other requested documentation
  • Process and distribute reprinted or adjusted invoices as needed
  • Provide high-touch support for complex or escalated customer accounts
  • Communicate professionally with both internal and external stakeholders throughout the collection process

Senior-Level Support & Team Collaboration

  • Serve as an Accounts Receivable subject matter resource for the team
  • Provide training, coaching, and mentorship to other AR Representatives on processes and best practices
  • Assist team members with complex AR situations and escalations
  • Provide coverage for other team members when needed
  • Support reporting and payment platforms such as Tableau and SnapPay, as applicable
  • Identify opportunities to improve AR processes, workflows, and overall efficiency
  • Consistently work toward meeting or exceeding established aging and performance KPIs
  • Perform additional responsibilities based on team needs and assigned workflows

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in Accounts Receivable, Billing, Collections, Finance, or a related function
  • Strong experience managing customer accounts and past-due receivables
  • Experience communicating directly with customers regarding outstanding balances and payment resolution
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities and meet deadlines
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a team
  • Ability to remain professional and solution-oriented when handling escalated or complex accounts
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Outlook

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a corporate or B2B Accounts Receivable environment
  • Experience managing complex or high-value customer accounts
  • Strong 10-key speed and accuracy
  • Experience mentoring or supporting other AR professionals
  • Experience with Tableau, SnapPay, or similar financial/reporting platforms
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Finance, Account Management, and Customer Service

Who Will Succeed in This Role?

You'll be a strong fit if you're someone who takes ownership of your accounts rather than waiting for problems to escalate. You're comfortable picking up the phone and speaking with customers, investigating discrepancies, coordinating with multiple departments, and following an issue through until it's resolved.

You're also someone your teammates can rely on. You enjoy sharing your knowledge, helping others navigate difficult accounts, and contributing to a strong and collaborative AR team.

Ready for Your Next Opportunity?

If you're an experienced Accounts Receivable professional looking for a remote opportunity where you can take greater ownership, work with complex accounts, and continue developing your career, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and take the next step in your career with Alia Services.

Your team

This position combines account ownership with deep technological and investigative expertise. You will work closely with Sales, Product, Presales and Customer Success to drive meaningful conversations with customers and position TRG’s solutions in complex, high-stakes environments.

About you

As an IntelligenceOfficer in the Sales team at TRG, you will own and drive the sales cycle within your assigned territory, while leveraging your background in intelligence and analysis to engage customers on a deeper, more consultative level.

This is not a traditional “quota-only” sales role, you will act as a trusted advisor, bringing structure to complex intelligence problems, guiding customers through data-driven insights, and demonstrating how TRG’s technology can support real-world investigations.

You will play a key role in shaping opportunities, influencing strategy, and bridging the gap between customer needs and product capabilities.

Descripción completa del empleo

Department: Sales / Business Development

Work Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST
