jobs.title: Services Analytics Team Leader
jobs.description:
You will lead analytics for the Services cluster — the set of domains that protect trust, safety, and quality across every interaction on our platform. This is where the integrity of the marketplace is safeguarded and where millions of passengers and drivers experience inDrive as a safe and reliable place to be. Your teams will span five closely connected areas: Watchdocs (driver document verification and work with the compliance base), Trust & Safety (everything related to trust and safety in rides — incidents and safety features), Customer Support (both the product tooling for handling user requests and the automation of that work, plus WFM analytics of support agents' performance), Customer Experience (Voice-of-the-Customer feedback and connecting satisfaction metrics such as CSAT/DSAT to business metrics), and Antifraud (protecting rides, transactions, ratings, and more from abuse across inDrive).
You will build and manage a team that partners closely with product, operations, support, and compliance to turn a large volume of behavioral, operational, and feedback signals into decisions that reduce risk and improve experience at the same time. From detecting and quantifying fraud across rides and transactions, to measuring the real business impact of safety features and support automation, to linking customer-feedback metrics (CSAT/DSAT) with core business outcomes — your work will define how the company balances protection, cost, and user satisfaction.
In this role, you will act as a strategic partner to product and business leaders, as well as to Trust & Safety and Compliance stakeholders — shaping the analytics agenda for the Services cluster, defending its strategy in front of senior leadership, and building scalable processes, metrics, and standards that make trust and safety measurable across the whole platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the analytics strategy and roadmap for the Services cluster (Watchdocs, Trust & Safety, Customer Support, CX, Antifraud), align it with company-level priorities, and defend it in front of senior leadership
  • Build, grow, and develop a team of 11+ (analysts) — hiring, mentoring, and setting quality standards across the cluster
  • Lead Antifraud analytics: detect and quantify fraudulent behavior across rides, transactions, and ratings; evaluate the effectiveness of anti-fraud rules and models and their trade-off with false positives
  • Drive Trust & Safety analytics: measure incident rates, evaluate the impact of safety features, and help prioritize initiatives that reduce risk for passengers and drivers
  • Oversee Customer Support analytics: assess support tooling and automation effectiveness, contact-rate drivers, resolution quality, and WFM analytics for agent capacity and performance
  • Lead CX analytics: connect Voice-of-the-Customer metrics (CSAT/DSAT) to business outcomes such as retention and revenue, and turn feedback into prioritized product and operational actions

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Experience scaling analytics across multiple countries and verticals

Nice to have

  • A genuinely broad role with direct access to senior leadership and a clear growth path as our security programme and product line grow

  • An annual training budget to support role-relevant development and certifications

  • A role where security visibly matters to the business and its route to market

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Chamorro-English Phone Interpreter

Job Title: Chamorro Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Phone Interpreter

Status: Independent Contractor

Pay: $1.25 - $1.40 per minute

  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.
  • **This is an independent contractor position and therefore not eligible for employee benefits.**

Position Overview:

The Chamorro Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Chamorroand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**

Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.

jobs.description:
About Us

Tameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online. We are looking for a Head of Technical Content to take end-to-end ownership of our technical presence.

About the Role

This is not a standard copywriting role or strategist role. We want someone with an engineering mind and a marketing insight, someone who figures things out, builds things, and ships them without waiting to be told. Someone who understands who our customers are: engineers and procurement teams at small and medium businesses sourcing industrial components, and what they need to make a confident purchase decision. If you are excited about building AI-driven content pipelines, that matters more than a long track record.

You will own technical content from strategy to publication, including its technical accuracy. Your output shapes how engineers find Tameson, how the site ranks, and whether visitors convert into buyers. You work closely with our Product and Operations teams to extract technical knowledge and turn it into content competitors cannot replicate.

A Flavor of What You’d Work On

  • Audit our solenoid valve categories, identify what is missing or underperforming, and decide whether the fix is a selection guide, a page restructure, JSON-LD, or additional supporting content. Build it and analyze performance.

  • Take our internal valve performance test data and turn it into a content series: articles, comparison tables, video scripts, email campaigns, social posts. Build assets from proprietary data that competitors cannot replicate.

  • Work with industry partners to reach their communities through forums, sponsored placements, or native articles on their platforms.

  • Analyze pages that get traffic but do not convert. Investigate whether it is a traffic quality, content quality, or conversion issue, implement a fix, and track the result against sales.

  • Get up to speed on a product you know little about, write a buyer guide, fact-check it against manufacturer datasheets, and publish it without a technical reviewer.

Key Outcomes & Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Ownership: You will identify gaps in our content, style, and approach. You own the solution from idea to publication. You do not wait for a task list. You analyze the site, find the opportunities, and execute the improvements that drive the biggest impact.

  • Strategic Content Architecture: You decide the format that converts. Sometimes an article is best, but often the customer needs a flow calculator, a comparison table, an upgraded category page, a tooltip, diagram, video, or a selection wizard. You will build the right content for the job to build our brand and convert users.

  • Technical Authority & Accuracy: You are responsible for the technical accuracy of all public-facing content. You must have high engineering knowledge to validate data, correct errors, and ensure our advice is sound. You are the filter that prevents AI hallucinations or inaccuracies from reaching the customer.

  • Build the Content Moat: You will create unique value that competitors and AI models cannot replicate. Go beyond text to produce proprietary assets like physical product benchmarks, expert interviews, and deep-dive technical diagrams or videos.

  • Optimize for the Audience: You will structure information to ensure our content ranks high for search engines, serves as a primary citation source for AI models, and provides clear, helpful guidance for humans (engineers, non-engineers, buyers, etc.).

  • Agile Adaptation: You will stay ahead of marketing trends and follow the data. If a content format stops working, you pivot. You track traffic and conversion metrics to continuously refine your strategy.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

  • High Engineering Knowledge: You have a background in engineering, deep experience in technical industries, and can explain the physics of our products easily.

  • Builds With AI: You have designed and built content workflows using AI: research pipelines, structured drafting processes, automated publishing steps. You chose the tools, connected them, and own the quality of what comes out.

  • Outcome Owner: You are driven by results (traffic, conversion, revenue) rather than output (article or word count). You manage the roadmap and deliver end-to-end results.

  • Collaborative Investigator: You do not work in a silo. You actively partner with our Product and Operations teams to extract their internal expertise. You work with them and translate their knowledge into public-facing content that sets us apart from competitors.

  • Versatile Creator: You are comfortable switching formats and could work on writing a white paper, designing calculator logic, auditing category pages, and building dashboards to analyze results all in 1 week.

Why Choose Tameson?

  • Direct Business Impact: Your work directly correlates to sales. Publish the right guide and you can watch organic traffic and conversions move. There is a direct line between what you produce and company revenue.

  • Innovation: We are an aggressive, modern company. We want you to experiment with new formats, tools, and strategies.

  • Company culture: We value collaboration, professional growth, and fun. We regularly have company activities (online and offline) to stay connected and inspired.

  • Growth: We are scaling rapidly. As we expand, your professional opportunities grow.

Role Work Conditions

  • Employment type: Full time position (remote).

  • Working hours: Flexible work hours, with availability required Monday through Friday and a minimum overlap of 12:00–17:00 GMT+1.

  • Contract type: You will join as an independent contractor. To simplify hiring outside our registered countries, we engage global talent through freelance contracts.

Ready to define the future of industrial e-commerce?

If you have the technical mind to understand our products and the strategic mind to market them, apply today.

Highlights

Tameson seeks a remote Head of Technical Content to build authority, create expert content, and optimize for AI. Independent contractor role.

jobs.title: ML Platform Engineer, Evaluation Systems
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for an ML Platform Engineer, Evaluation Systems to build and maintain the infrastructure that allows Bask Health to evaluate machine learning models and AI-powered applications reliably, consistently, and at scale.

Bask Health supports direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses through a platform that connects patient experiences, merchant operations, clinical workflows, pharmacy coordination, and commerce capabilities. As machine learning and AI become more integrated into these systems, we need dependable infrastructure for measuring model quality, comparing changes, and understanding how AI systems perform before and after deployment.

You'll help develop the platform services, data pipelines, execution environments, and monitoring capabilities that support machine learning evaluation across engineering teams.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on the operational infrastructure behind evaluation systems. You'll work with cloud services, distributed processing, model integrations, databases, and automated workflows to support repeatable experiments and large-scale evaluation jobs.

Your work may include building evaluation job orchestration, managing benchmark datasets, developing experiment tracking systems, supporting model comparisons, and creating infrastructure that stores and analyzes evaluation results.

You'll collaborate with machine learning engineers, applied scientists, AI evaluation engineers, and backend engineers to understand their technical requirements and build reusable systems that support different model types and evaluation methodologies.

You'll also help improve the reliability and reproducibility of evaluation workflows. This includes ensuring experiments can be repeated, datasets and configurations are versioned, failures are observable, and results can be compared accurately over time.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, evaluation infrastructure must support appropriate privacy controls, secure data access, and responsible handling of sensitive information. You'll help ensure evaluation datasets and model outputs are managed according to approved security and operational requirements.

This position emphasizes strong infrastructure engineering, practical machine learning knowledge, and ownership of production platform services. You'll contribute to architecture, build scalable systems, improve operational performance, and help engineering teams evaluate AI capabilities more effectively.

We're looking for an engineer who enjoys building infrastructure for machine learning teams, understands the challenges of reproducible experimentation, and wants to make AI evaluation more dependable and efficient across the organization.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain machine learning evaluation infrastructure across Bask Health.
  • Develop platform services that execute and manage automated model evaluation workloads.
  • Build scalable systems for running large batches of model and AI application evaluations.
  • Implement job orchestration, scheduling, and execution management for evaluation pipelines.
  • Develop infrastructure for storing and versioning evaluation datasets.
  • Build systems for tracking model configurations, prompts, parameters, and evaluation results.
  • Implement reproducible experiment workflows that support consistent model comparisons.
  • Develop automated pipelines for benchmarking machine learning models.
  • Build APIs and services that allow engineering teams to submit and monitor evaluation jobs.
  • Create infrastructure for comparing evaluation results across model versions and experiments.
  • Support evaluation workflows for large language models, predictive models, and retrieval systems.
  • Develop asynchronous processing systems for computationally intensive evaluation tasks.
  • Implement monitoring for evaluation job performance, failures, latency, and resource usage.
  • Build logging and tracing capabilities that help engineers investigate evaluation problems.
  • Develop systems for managing evaluation artifacts, reports, and historical results.
  • Integrate evaluation infrastructure with model registries and ML development workflows.
  • Implement automated quality checks that support controlled model releases.
  • Build reliable retry, timeout, and failure recovery mechanisms for evaluation workloads.
  • Optimize evaluation execution performance, infrastructure utilization, and operational costs.
  • Support distributed evaluation workloads across cloud-based compute resources.
  • Collaborate with machine learning engineers to define evaluation infrastructure requirements.
  • Work with applied scientists to support reproducible experiments and benchmark comparisons.
  • Develop tools that simplify evaluation configuration and execution for engineering teams.
  • Implement secure access controls for evaluation datasets and results.
  • Ensure evaluation systems respect tenant boundaries and approved data-handling practices.
  • Investigate infrastructure incidents and improve evaluation platform reliability.
  • Document evaluation infrastructure, deployment procedures, and operational standards.
  • Own assigned ML evaluation platform projects from technical design through deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, platform engineering, or a closely related technical field.
  • Experience building and maintaining production backend services or infrastructure.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, TypeScript, or comparable languages.
  • Familiarity with machine learning development and evaluation workflows.
  • Experience developing APIs and backend service integrations.
  • Understanding of distributed systems and asynchronous processing.
  • Experience working with cloud-based infrastructure and production deployments.
  • Familiarity with automated testing and continuous integration practices.
  • Understanding of machine learning model versioning and experiment reproducibility.
  • Experience working with relational databases and structured datasets.
  • Familiarity with data pipelines and batch processing workflows.
  • Experience designing reliable background job systems.
  • Understanding of infrastructure scalability, performance, and fault tolerance.
  • Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and production observability.
  • Experience implementing retries, timeouts, and error recovery.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, and secure service communication.
  • Familiarity with configuration management and deployment automation.
  • Experience writing maintainable, well-tested production code.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex backend or infrastructure issues.
  • Understanding of software release processes and operational reliability.
  • Experience using Git and collaborative engineering workflows.
  • Ability to translate machine learning requirements into scalable infrastructure.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with machine learning engineers, applied scientists, and software engineers.
  • Ability to independently own engineering projects from design through deployment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building infrastructure for machine learning evaluation or experimentation.
  • Familiarity with MLflow, Weights & Biases, or comparable experiment tracking platforms.
  • Experience with model registries and artifact management systems.
  • Familiarity with large language model evaluation frameworks.
  • Experience with LangSmith, DeepEval, Ragas, or comparable AI evaluation tools.
  • Experience building distributed evaluation or benchmarking pipelines.
  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or Temporal.
  • Experience with containerized workloads and distributed compute infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience working with AWS Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, or related cloud services.
  • Familiarity with AWS SageMaker or comparable ML platform services.
  • Experience with serverless infrastructure and infrastructure-as-code tools.
  • Familiarity with SST or comparable application deployment frameworks.
  • Experience developing data versioning and dataset management systems.
  • Understanding of reproducible machine learning experimentation.
  • Experience implementing model performance monitoring and drift detection.
  • Familiarity with large language model APIs and model comparison workflows.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms for machine learning teams.
  • Understanding of HIPAA and healthcare data privacy considerations.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.

  • Keep clients informed about the status of their requests and manage expectations clearly;
  • Manage your ticket queue in Zendesk, prioritizing by urgency and SLA;
  • Track recurring issues and share insights that help improve the product and the client experience.
  • Provide high-touch, multi-channel technical support (email, tickets, and occasional live sessions) to resolve complex issues for corporate enterprise clients.

What you need to succeed in this role:

  • Excellent English communication skills (at least C1 for both spoken and written);
  • Previous experience in a technical support role supporting a technical product (software, SaaS, app, or platform);
  • Understanding of basic cloud concepts (SaaS, cloud-hosted vs. installed software, user access and permissions) and common issues in cloud-based products;
  • Structured troubleshooting skills: confirming the scope of an issue, gathering details, reproducing the problem, and escalating with complete and clear information;
  • Hands-on experience with ticketing systems, including managing queues, priorities, SLAs, and internal notes;
  • Hands-on experience with Zendesk;
  • Tech-savvy, with the ability to learn new products, tools, and processes quickly;
  • Customer-oriented and responsible attitude;
  • Excellent interpersonal skills.

Will be a great plus:

  • 2+ years of experience in a Technical Support, Application Support, or Technical Account Management role handling B2B software environments;
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, Microsoft 365, or Google Workspace;
  • Understanding of cloud architecture (SaaS/IaaS), network basics, and enterprise access controls;
  • Experience using centralized logging tools to investigate connectivity or permission issues.

Benefits:

  • Opportunity to cooperate fully remotely;
  • Inclusive international environment;
  • Compensation in USD;

  • Balance between project workload and personal time, but also – internal health policy;

jobs.title: Senior Conversion Rate Optimization Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
stellenausschreibung

Mit unserer Marke deinSchrank.de stehen wir für maßgefertigte Möbel „Made in Germany“. In unserer eigenen Produktion fertigen wir in Losgröße 1 und begeistern Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa – überwiegend über unsere digitalen Kanäle.
Unser Marketing bauen wir gerade neu auf. Ein zentraler Hebel für unser Wachstum ist eine konsequent getestete Customer Experience – vom ersten Besuch über die Planung im Konfigurator bis zur Bestellung. Dafür suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt – remote aus ganz Deutschland – eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit als Senior Conversion Rate Optimization Manager (m/w/d).

das erwartet dich

  • Du verantwortest die Conversion-Optimierung unserer Online-Shops und baust ein systematisches Testprogramm auf, in dem dauerhaft Tests laufen.
  • Du entwickelst Hypothesen aus Daten, Nutzerverhalten, Kundenfeedback und Wettbewerbsvergleichen und priorisierst sie in einem transparenten Backlog.
  • Du konzipierst A/B-Tests, setzt Varianten KI-gestützt um – etwa Mockups, Texte und Layouts – und wertest sie statistisch sauber aus.
  • Du optimierst unseren Online-Konfigurator, Produktseiten, Checkout und Landingpages und reduzierst gezielt Hürden und Abbrüche im Planungs- und Kaufprozess.
  • Wo der Traffic für A/B-Tests nicht reicht, arbeitest du mit qualitativen Methoden wie Session-Analysen, Heatmaps und Nutzerbefragungen.
  • Du dokumentierst Ergebnisse und Learnings in einem Testlog und stellst sie regelmäßig im Management und im Team vor.
  • Du baust agentische Workflows für Analyse, Variantenentwicklung und Reporting auf.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Performance Marketing, CRM, Content, Design und unserer Webentwicklung zusammen.

das solltest du mitbringen

  • Langjährige Erfahrung in der Conversion-Optimierung, idealerweise im E-Commerce, mit einer großen Zahl selbst verantworteter Tests
  • Ein gutes Gespür dafür, welche Änderungen wirklich verkaufen – und nicht nur, was gut aussieht
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Testmethodik und Statistik, z. B. Signifikanz, Laufzeiten und Stichprobengrößen
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Analyse- und Testing-Tools wie GA4, Microsoft Clarity oder gängigen A/B-Testing-Plattformen
  • Ein ausgeprägtes UX-Verständnis; Webdesign-Kenntnisse sind ein Plus, Programmierkenntnisse sind nicht erforderlich
  • Eine starke KI-Affinität und Erfahrung darin, Mockups, Varianten und Analysen mit KI-Tools zu erstellen
  • Durchsetzungsstärke und die Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse auch auf Management-Ebene überzeugend zu vertreten
  • Erfahrung mit konfigurierbaren oder erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten ist von Vorteil
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse; Niederländisch ist ein Plus
  • Eine eigenverantwortliche, strukturierte Arbeitsweise; ein Wohnort im Raum Köln/Bonn ist ein Plus

das bieten wir dir

  • Großen Gestaltungsspielraum beim Aufbau unseres Testprogramms – inklusive der Freiheit, es mit KI-Agenten zu skalieren – und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Ein sicheres Arbeitsverhältnis mit einer fairen, leistungsgerechten Vergütung in einem wachstumsstarken, innovativen Unternehmen
  • Moderne Tools und eine eigene KI-Infrastruktur für das Marketing
  • 30 Urlaubstage und eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung
  • Eine offene Kommunikationskultur, flache Hierarchien und ein familienfreundliches Arbeitsumfeld
  • Eine gezielte Einarbeitung sowie Weiterbildung und Förderung deiner Entwicklung
  • Rabatte auf unsere Möbel, „Family and Friends“-Angebote und weitere Mitarbeitervorteile
  • Remote-Arbeit aus ganz Deutschland und regelmäßige Mitarbeiter-Events vor Ort

die nächsten schritte

Du willst unsere Shops messbar besser machen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung mit zwei bis drei Beispielen aus deinen bisherigen Tests (Hypothese, Ergebnis, Learning), deinem frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung – per E-Mail an

Wir freuen uns auf dich!

jobs.title: FBS - Enterprise Learning Training Design Manager
jobs.description:
Our Client is one of the United States’ largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premiums well over US$25 Billion (P&C). They proudly serve more than 10 million U.S. households with more than 19 million individual policies across all 50 states through the efforts of over 48,000 exclusive and independent agents and nearly 18,500 employees. Finally, our Client is part of one the largest Insurance Groups in the world.

About the Role

The Enterprise Learning Training Design Manager will lead the CAS Training Design team in developing high-quality, scalable learning experiences that improve employee capabilities, operational performance, retention, and business results across Farmers.

This role manages Learning Experience Designers, Content Developers, and rotational design resources, providing direction, coaching, and quality oversight to ensure learning solutions meet consistent instructional, visual design, accessibility, and technical standards.

The team is evolving from a traditional trainer-led delivery model toward a modern, capability-based learning ecosystem that embeds learning into everyday work through technology, performance support, and leaders as teachers. As a key leader in this transformation, you will help determine the most effective learning approach for each business need, whether that means developing an interactive digital module, a concise job aid, a short video, or resources that enable supervisors to coach employees directly.

  • Experience reviewing learning materials and providing detailed feedback on instructional effectiveness, visual design, accessibility, usability, and technical quality.

We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Chipewyan-English Phone Interpreter

Job Title: Chipewyan Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Phone Interpreter

Status: Independent Contractor

Pay: $1.25 - $1.40 per minute

We Offer:

  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.
  • **This is an independent contractor position and therefore not eligible for employee benefits.**

Position Overview:

The Chipewyan Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Chipewyanand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**

Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inChipewyanand English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages - highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**

Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.
  • Restricted brands:
    • Kaspersky products.
    • Huawei hardware.
  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.
  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer the majority of the workday.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.
  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.
  • May be exposed to moderate noise levels; i.e. computer, audio, telephone.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Are you an analytical problem-solver who enjoys turning data into actionable insights? Do you thrive on keeping complex accounts organized, spotting service trends, and helping a team stay ahead of client needs?

City Wide is seeking an Enterprise Account Operations Analyst to support our Enterprise Account Management team. In this remote role, you’ll connect data, systems, and day-to-day operations so account managers can focus on strengthening client relationships and driving growth.

Reporting to the Director of Enterprise Account Management, you’ll manage reporting, coordinate account updates, prepare quarterly business review materials, and identify issues that need attention. This role is ideal for someone who combines advanced Excel skills with strong communication, initiative, and follow-through.

What You’ll Do

  • Support enterprise accounts by maintaining accurate CRM records, coordinating work order updates, and prioritizing high-revenue clients and time-sensitive requests.
  • Navigate client procurement and vendor platforms, including Ariba, Coupa, and ServiceChannel, to keep work orders and account activity moving.
  • Build recurring and ad hoc reports using Excel, CRM data, and Power BI to support account management decisions.
  • Analyze service complaints, inspection results, and account performance to identify trends, flag risks, and recommend areas for follow-up.
  • Prepare organized, accurate quarterly business review (QBR) materials, including client spend, service-level performance, and key account metrics.
  • Support QBR calls for top-revenue accounts through meeting coordination, real-time data support, and post-call documentation.
  • Track master service agreement terms, renewal dates, price adjustment dates, and other contract milestones for account managers’ review.
  • Monitor DocuSign submissions, follow up on pending approvals, and maintain complete account documentation and client contact information.
  • Provide scheduled account updates, triage internal inquiries, and escalate issues to the appropriate account manager or leader.
  • Coordinate quarterly Loyalty Loop surveys and track schedules, delivery, and responses.
  • Provide client and operational coverage during account manager vacations, escalating decisions when needed.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting, automate routine tasks, and strengthen team processes.

What Success Looks Like

You’ll succeed by delivering accurate reports on time, keeping account information current, preparing thorough QBR materials, and identifying service issues before they become larger problems. Your responsiveness, sound judgment, and dependable support will help the Enterprise Account Management team stay informed and prepared.

Requirements

What You Bring

  • 2–4 years of experience in customer success, account management support, operations, or business analysis, preferably in a B2B or enterprise service environment.
  • High school diploma or GED required; an associate degree in business, data analytics, or a related field preferred.
  • Expert-level Microsoft Excel skills, including VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, and advanced formulas, along with proficiency in Microsoft Office.
  • Experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot and reporting or visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar systems.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders, deadlines, and competing priorities.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn complex data into useful insights.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to accurate records, reliable reporting, and timely follow-through.
  • Confidence working with senior account managers and leadership, including the ability to ask questions, flag concerns, and push back professionally.
  • A proactive, curious approach to problem-solving and a willingness to handle both detailed administrative work and broader analytical projects.
  • Experience with third-party procurement platforms, SQL, and AI-assisted reporting or automation tools such as Claude Enterprise is a plus.

Benefits

City Wide Facility Solutions offers a competitive compensation and benefits, including Medical, Dental, Vision, Basic Life, Voluntary Life, Accident, Critical Illness, Short Term Disability.

More on City Wide...

City Wide Facility Solutions is a fast-growing company with over 100 franchise locations across the United States and Canada. Founded in 1961, City Wide Facility Solutions is the largest management company in the building maintenance industry. We have over 60 years in the business and continue to experience high growth and profitability across our franchise businesses. Our culture supports the company’s Mission to create a Ripple Effect by positively impacting the people and communities they serve. Read more about City Wide at

City Wide is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:
The Senior Governance, Risk, and Compliance Specialist is tasked with providing assurance and automation of CrowdStrike’s global compliance program. The primary
function will involve leading audit and compliance functions in relation to CrowdStrike’s applicable frameworks, external attestations and certifications, and internal audits.

What You'll Do:
The ideal candidate will be up to the challenge of understanding current processes and proactively searching for ways to improve CrowdStrike’s information security program.
In addition, this role will build scalable automation solutions that integrate controls across our systems and processes. This role covers audit and compliance processes in
the context of security, privacy and other enterprise-wide operational areas such as:

  • Leading internal and external compliance audits/assessments by independent third party auditors.

  • Developing custom integrations between internal systems to communicate or transfer applicable information

  • Identify and create new automation capabilities to streamline audit program

  • Performing other duties within the scope of governance, risk, and compliance, as required.

What You’ll Need:

  • Practical experience or familiarity with compliance frameworks like SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 20000-1, ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 27701, and ISO/IEC 42001.

  • Functional experience with assuring compliance programs, and a level of comfort with effectively communicating with internal and external stakeholders

  • Proficiency in scripting languages (i.e., Python, Bash, PowerShell)

  • Experience with workflow automation and orchestration tools

  • At least 5 years job-related experience, or a BA or BS / MA or MS degree in Computer Science/Engineering, Math, Information Security, Information Systems, Information Assurance, Information Security Management, Intelligence Studies, Data Science, Cybersecurity, or other related field with at least 3 years experience.

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Bonus Points:

  • Program and project management experience in scoping, work break-down, critical path analysis, resourcing, managing time estimates, project risks, and quality.

  • Ability to think strategically about risks and tie those risks to tactical organizational activities.

  • Experience with cloud environments and CrowdStrike’s products or services.

  • Experience with modern AI toolsets either for programming or in the compliance space.

jobs.description:
LanguageLine Solutions is Hiring!

At LanguageLine, we strive for a world in which language and cultural barriers no longer exist. Use your language skills to dramatically improve the lives of limited-English speakers, as well as the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing. Even better, you can do this while working from your own home.

LanguageLine has been certified as a Great Place to Work, and is regularly listed as one of America’s top work-from-home employers.

Our interpreters serve clients across numerous industries, including health care, 911, first responders, education, government agencies, and all walks of business.

As an interpreter, you will receive training that is the best in the industry. We’ll ensure that you learn new skills while further developing your skillset. We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Ewe -English Phone Interpreter

Job Title: Ewe Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Phone Interpreter

Status: Independent Contractor

Pay: $0.70 - $0.85 per minute.

We Offer:

  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.
  • **This is an independent contractor position and therefore not eligible for employee benefits.**

Position Overview:

The Ewe Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Eweand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**

Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inEweand English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages - highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**

Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.
  • Restricted brands:
    • Kaspersky products.
    • Huawei hardware.
  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.
  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer the majority of the workday.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.
  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.
  • May be exposed to moderate noise levels; i.e. computer, audio, telephone.

Applications will be accepted for Twenty-Four (24) days from the posting date of August 28, 2026.

EEO/AA

LLS is an equal opportunity employer, meaning that employment opportunities are made and offered to individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, or any other characteristic protected by federal or state law or local ordinance. LLS will reasonably accommodate employees and applicants with disabilities if the person is otherwise qualified to safely perform all of the essential functions of the position. Should you require accommodations to complete this application and/or the interview process, please let us know immediately.

Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race. color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, pregnancy, genetic information or any other consideration prohibited by law or contract.

VEVRAA Federal Contractor requesting appropriate employment service delivery systems, such as state workforce agencies and local employment delivery systems, to provide priority referrals of protected veterans.

PAY TRANSPARENCY NONDISCRIMINATION PROVISION
The contractor will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60-I.35(c)

Remote Care Manager

Location: Remote

The Care Manager will be assigned a patient panel based on skill and efficiency level and is expected to carry a patient panel of a minimum of 30- 50 patients per calendar month within the first three months of assignment (depending on patient availability at the assigned practice location). Care Managers are expected to complete due diligence on 100% of their assigned patients and complete billable encounters on 90% of the patients they are assigned each month unless patients are unable to participate due to current health conditions.

Compensation Structure

Esrun Health utilizes a productivity-based pay structure:

$10.00 per completed patient encounter up to 99 encounters/month.

$10.25 100-149 encounters/month

$12.00 150-199 encounters/month,

$14.00 200-249 encounters/month

$16.00 >250 encounters/month.

Payment tier increases require 2 months consistency to achieve and are awarded in third month.

There is a $1/encounter incentive compensation for bilingual contractors equal to $3/hr but is only applied if hired into a bilingual position.

  • Monthly outreach will consist of cumulative time to include chart review, contact attempts (calls/texts/emails), actual call time, care coordination, and documentation/billing.
  • This time is billed out in 20-minute units of service referred to as “encounters” and each patient can be billed for up to three units of service or “encounters” each month.
  • (20-39m=1 encounter, 40-59m=2 encounters, >60m=3 encounters)
    • EXAMPLE: Chart Review 8 min

Outreach Attempts: 6 min

Actual Call:11 min

Care Coordination:9 min

Total Time Spent:44 min = 2 encounters

  • As a productivity-based position – there is no compensation outside of the billable encounters described in the compensation structure other than goal bonuses, referral bonuses, and employee engagement activities resulting in monetary prizes.
  • There is no pay for onboarding until care manager completes billable encounters. Onboarding is self-led and can be completed in as little as 3 days (2-3hrs total time for initial orientation and 1-2 days for workflow training once assigned) – but can, depending on individual schedule, take up to 14 days.

Compensation range: AUD $2,500 – $3,500 per month

Engagement type:Independent Contractor Agreement/Full-Time

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (70% of their time) for collaboration. This is a full time role.

Who We Are:

At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is:

Brick Me is a fast-growing, internationally recognised eCommerce brand specialising in highly personalised, custom-made keepsake products. With a strong direct-to-consumer presence and a loyal global customer base, the business has built an excellent reputation for quality, creativity, and exceptional customer experience. They operate across multiple international markets and are now investing further in growing their brand and online community.

Role Overview: We're hiring a Social Media & Community Manager who treats our brand like it's their own. This is a hands-on, end-to-end role — strategy and execution. You'll own how Brick Me shows up on social media, how we talk with our community, and how we get featured in places that matter.

This isn't a "post 3x a week and call it done" role. We want someone who's genuinely excited about the product, gets the brand voice quickly, and brings ideas we wouldn't have thought of.

Key Responsibilities:

Social media management

- Run our Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and Pinterest. Build the content strategy, plan the calendar, write the copy, schedule posts, track what's working, adjust accordingly.

Community management

- Reply to comments and DMs across organic posts and paid ads. Answer questions, stay on top of brand-relevant conversations, and pass complaints or feedback to our customer service team. Post on Reddit and engage authentically with the communities our audience lives in.

Influencer marketing
- Manage brand collabs end-to-end. Respond to inbound collab requests, proactively find creators who fit us, negotiate terms, brief them properly, and enforce our brand guidelines. We need someone who can spot the difference between a creator who'll drive real engagement and one who just looks good on paper.

Content management
- Curate UGC from customers and video creators. Build a content strategy and brief our designers to produce content for organic social and paid ads. You won't be designing yourself, but you'll know what good looks like and direct accordingly.

Digital PR
- Pitch and engage with publications, blogs, and websites to get Brick Me featured. Build relationships with editors and writers in our space.

Requirements

• 5+ years of relevant experience managing social and community for consumer brands (DTC ecommerce experience strongly preferred)

• Should have experience with Reddit

• Hands-on experience running Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and Pinterest
• Excellent written English — strong communication skills as the voice of the brand
• Proven track record in influencer outreach and digital PR (not just basic social posting)
• Strategic thinker who can also execute effectively
• Self-starter who works independently and brings proactive ideas
• Passionate about brand-building (bonus if into design, craft, gifting, or personalised products)

Logistics

• Timezone: Minimum 70% overlap with Australian time zone (AEST/AEDT) — this is a hard requirement so we can collaborate in real time

• Start: Immediate

• Engagement: Long-term. We're looking for someone we can build a relationship with, not a short-term gig

We read every proposal. If you've used AI to write yours without adding your own thinking, we'll know.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

  • Support lead-generation activities across relevant digital channels.
  • Assist with nurturing prospects and improving marketing funnels.
  • Help identify opportunities to improve enquiries and conversions.

Paid Advertising

  • Assist with the setup, management and optimisation of Google Ads and/or Meta Ads campaigns where required.
  • Monitor campaign performance and key metrics.
  • Test audiences, messaging and creative to improve results.

Analytics & Reporting

  • Track website, social media, campaign and lead-generation performance.
  • Monitor key metrics including traffic, engagement, enquiries and conversions.
  • Prepare regular marketing reports.
  • Identify what is working, what isn't and recommend improvements.

AI & Marketing Technology

  • Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other relevant platforms to improve productivity and marketing output.

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive marketing tasks.

  • Experience with content marketing and email marketing.

The Lead Data Engineer provides hands-on technical leadership in the design, development, and optimization of scalable data pipelines, ingestion frameworks, and data platforms. This role leads complex initiatives, ensures alignment with architectural standards, and drives delivery of high-quality, secure, reliable and properly governed data solutions and data platforms aligned with enterprise standards. Operating with significant independence, the Lead Data Engineer guides technical decision-making, mentors engineers, and ensures consistent implementation of best practices across teams. Serves as an escalation point for complex data engineering challenges.

The team currently uses SAS Viya and Amazon Redshift for data processing, automation, and reporting and is transitioning toward Snowflake. This role combines direct coding, troubleshooting, and support of existing workflows with participation in Snowflake engineering and design alongside enterprise engineering teams. Production ownership and new development remain core responsibilities as the future environment evolves.


What you will do:


• Lead the design and implementation of advanced data pipelines and ingestion frameworks. Personally develop, test, and maintain the underlying SQL, Python, and ETL code.

• Support and troubleshoot SAS Viya and SQL-based production workflows. Trace job failures and data discrepancies to root cause, implement safe corrections, validate outputs, and improve monitoring and recovery.

• Translate highly complex business requirements into scalable data solutions. Work with subject-matter experts to clarify business definitions and reconcile outputs into consistent, reusable datasets.

• Ensure data platforms are optimized for performance, scalability, and reliability. Consider Snowflake query performance and compute cost.

• Enforce data governance, security, and quality standards.

• Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership on projects. Share knowledge, document processes, and build backup ownership across the team.

• Lead code reviews and ensure adherence to engineering standards. Use version control, automated testing, and CI/CD practices to support safe releases.

• Collaborate with architects and stakeholders to align solutions with enterprise direction. Communicate technical decisions and production issues clearly to technical and nontechnical partners in a matrixed environment.

• Drive improvements in automation, efficiency, and platform capabilities.

• Support architectural discussions and contribute to design decisions. Help design Snowflake transformations, dimensional models, and shared analytics-ready data structures.

• Validate migrations through reconciliation, parallel runs, and rollback planning before retiring established workflows.

• Complete other duties as assigned.


What you will bring:


• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent combination of training and experience.

• 6–8+ years of data engineering experience with enterprise scale platforms.

• Advanced proficiency in SQL, including query optimization and complex transformations, and strong hands-on Python skills.

jobs.title: Academic Advisor & Student Support Specialist
jobs.description:
About ICL Academy

A new model of private online education: Connecting academics, student passions, and industry experts. ICL Academy is an online private school for grades 5-12 that aims to solve many problems facing in-person and online schools by focusing on student engagement through a personalized, blended approach that combines academics with personal passions. Its founder, Kirk Spahn, is a fourth-generation educator with over 20 years of experience specializing in digital education and youth civic engagement. ICL Academy is powered by 150 years of academic excellence. It builds on the track record of success of the Institute for Civic Leadership, a nonprofit founded in 2001 that has inspired, educated, and supported a new generation of youth civic leaders to take positive action in their local and global communities.

ICL Academy also partners with industry experts who serve as master teachers and Champion Mentors. ICL Academy is grateful to have amazing Champions such as Novak Djokovic, Steve Nash, Bode Miller, Monica Seles, Vincent Zhou, and so many more supporting its community of students and families. ICL Academy has quickly become the #1 online school for kids pursuing their passion.

Position Summary:

We seek a highly motivated, experienced professional to join the ICL Academy team as an Academic Advisor & Student Support Specialist. Reporting to the Dean of Counseling & Advising, this position plays an important role in supporting students and families throughout the admissions, academic planning, and enrollment process while maintaining a small caseload of ICL students.

The Academic Advisor & Student Support Specialist will partner closely with the Admissions, Academic Advising, Records, and instructional teams to review student transcripts and prior coursework, evaluate transferable credits, develop individualized four-year academic plans, and identify appropriate academic supports. This position will also oversee the review and documentation of 504 Plans, IEPs, and other accommodation-related documentation provided during enrollment and will collaborate with the Head of School, ICL Teachers, and Academic Advisors to support the implementation of appropriate accommodations within ICL’s flexible learning model.

As a member of the Academic Advising team, this position will develop meaningful relationships with students and families within their caseload and provide individualized academic planning, student support, and guidance throughout the student’s enrollment at ICL. The Academic Advisor & Student Support Specialist will also serve as a resource to the broader Academic Advising team on matters related to accommodations and other complex student support needs.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Admissions Academic Review & Course Planning:

  • Partner with the Admissions and Records teams to conduct academic reviews for prospective ICL Students in grades 5-12.
  • Review and evaluate student transcripts, academic records, and prior coursework to determine appropriate credit transfer and remaining graduation requirements.
  • Develop individualized four-year academic plans for incoming high school students that reflect transferred credits, current-year course placement, graduation requirements, and projected course planning through senior year.
  • Identify potential academic gaps, credit deficiencies, course sequencing considerations, or other academic factors that may impact a student’s pathway toward graduation. Work in collaboration with the Head of Admissions, Head of School, and Registrar on more complex individual transcript reviews and course planning.
  • Communicate academic findings and recommendations to the Admissions team to support informed enrollment and course placement decisions.
  • Partner with the Academic Advising team to ensure a smooth transition from the admissions process into ongoing academic advising.
  • Maintain accurate academic review documentation and four-year plans within the appropriate student information systems.

504, IEP, Psych-Ed Evaluations & Accommodation Support:

  • Review 504 Plans, IEPs, Psych-Ed Evaluations, and other educational support documentation provided during the admissions and enrollment process, or after enrollment.
  • Identify documented accommodations and determine their applicability within ICL Academy’s flexible instructional model.
  • Document relevant student support information and create and maintain ICL Accommodation Plan when applicable.
  • Maintain accurate and confidential records related to student accommodations and educational support needs.
  • Partner with Head of School, Academic Advisors and ICL Teachers to communicate and clarify student accommodations and support their appropriate implementation.
  • Collaborate with the Head of School and the Dean of Counseling & Advising when requested accommodations fall outside the scope of ICL’s flexible program and require additional consideration or support.
  • Partner with the Academic Advising team when students or families request testing accommodations for the ACT, SAT, or other standardized assessments.
  • Assist with the review and coordination of documentation required for standardized testing accommodations, as appropriate.

Student Advising & Support:

  • Maintain a small caseload of approximately 60 students and develop individualized, supportive relationships with students and families.
  • Serve as a consistent academic and student support resource for students within the Advisor’s caseload.
  • Monitor academic progress and proactively identify students who may benefit from additional academic, organizational, or school-based support.
  • Support students with academic planning, course selection, graduation requirements, goal setting, and post-secondary planning.
  • Maintain accurate and updated four-year plans for students within the Advisor’s caseload, incorporating transferred credits, current coursework, graduation requirements, and post-secondary goals.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of the National Collegiate Athletics Association (NCAA) eligibility guidelines and the University of California (UC) admissions requirements.
  • Guide a small number of senior students (if and when 12th graders are on the Advisor’s caseload) and their families in all aspects of the college admissions planning process, including the development of the college list, standardized testing, timing of applications, college essays, letters of recommendation, and financial aid and scholarships.
  • Collaborate with teachers, Academic Advisors, and families to develop appropriate strategies and supports for students experiencing academic challenges.
  • Support students with organization, time management, goal setting, and other executive functioning skills as appropriate.
  • Serve as a resource to Academic Advisors regarding accommodations, and other or student support matters including testing accommodations for the ACT/SAT..etc.
  • Refer students with significant academic, social-emotional, or mental health concerns to the Dean of Counseling & Advising or other appropriate resources.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date student records, including relevant academic, student support, and accommodation information.
  • Support student retention by proactively communicating with students and families and collaborating with the broader student support team.

Collaboration & School Support:

  • Work collaboratively with the Head of School, Dean of Counseling & Advising, Academic Advising, Admissions, Records, and instructional teams to support the academic success and well-being of ICL students.
  • Liaise with the Records and Academic Advising team as needed to ensure accuracy of student transcripts, credits, academic records, and graduation plans.
  • Participate/Lead in collaboration and student support meetings as appropriate.
  • Support the development and refinement of school-wide processes related to accommodations and student support.
  • Support and participate in key virtual webinars, orientations, and other programming designed to support students’ and families’ transition to ICL.
  • Participate in school-wide retention efforts and strategies.
  • In partnership with the Director of Community Engagement, support student and family engagement through participation in appropriate community-building events.
  • Support the planning and implementation of the school’s annual year-end celebration.
  • Attend the annual year-end celebration.
  • Additional duties as assigned.

Job Requirements, Skills, and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • Graduate degree in school counseling or academic advising strongly preferred.
  • Experience working with 504 Plans, IEPs, and/or student accommodations strongly preferred.
  • College admissions experience, at either the college or high school levels, preferred.
  • Tutoring and/or academic advising experience preferred.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound professional judgment when working with sensitive student information.
  • Familiarity with ACT and SAT testing accommodation processes preferred.
  • Technologically proficient in student information systems required.
  • Highly organized.
  • Outstanding interpersonal and community relations skills and the ability to communicate and work effectively within a diverse community.
  • Ability to foster a cooperative work environment.
  • A professional who operates with ethics and integrity.
  • High degree of flexibility.
  • Demonstrated ability to work well in a fast-paced environment.

Benefits:

  • Sponsored Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
  • Sponsored 401K Plan
  • Sponsored $50K Life Insurance included for all employees
  • Flexible PTO
  • Remote/Work from Home and flexible hours
  • Professional development

ICL Academy is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating a diverse workforce. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or any other status of an individual or that individual’s associates or relatives that is protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.
