jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
About Us
Gather AI is the Physical AI platform for logistics. We give the companies that run the world’s warehouses ground truth on every product and every movement, dock to dock.
Our platform reads the warehouse floor through autonomous drones and cameras mounted on material handling equipment, then turns what it sees into intelligence and action. Facilities run safer and more accurately, with fewer ladders and fewer manual counts. If you want to do the defining design work for a new category in a vital industry, we’d like to meet you.
About the Team
Product at Gather AI sits at an unusual intersection: we build software for people who work on warehouse floors, not at desks. Our users are associates checking inventory on a tablet from the seat of a forklift, shift teams running drone workflows, field technicians troubleshooting on site, and facility leaders reading AI-generated insights in Sage.
Design here is about more than pixels, though craft matters a lot. It starts with understanding how people work under pressure, and it ends with software that gets out of their way and looks as advanced as the technology behind it.
About the Role
Most design roles ask you to improve something that already exists. This one asks you to define what good looks like for a new category of product.
You’ll be Gather AI’s first and only designer. You’ll own design end to end, from field research and information architecture to visual craft and working prototypes. Your work spans the apps floor teams use alongside our drones and MHE Vision systems, and Sage, our AI insights layer. The job is to help the product team ship products that solve real problems and happen to be very well designed, not to make screens for their own sake.
You won’t design from assumptions. You’ll stand next to the people using our software and let what you see shape what you build.
We’d love you near our Pittsburgh office, and we’ll seriously consider strong candidates anywhere in the US. The role includes about 20% travel, roughly one trip a month, to customer sites in Houston and Dallas and to our Pittsburgh office.
There’s no established design team to slot into, and that’s the point. You’ll set the standard and build the foundations, with a visible path to Director of UX as design at Gather AI grows.
What You’ll Do

  • Own design for the MHEV app: ramp fast and propose a v2 concept by month 3, then take full ownership of the product line
  • Design interfaces for people working directly with drones and forklifts: tablet experiences used mid-shift, in noisy environments and under time pressure, where clarity is the whole job
  • Expand into the Sage dashboard as your second product line, shaping an AI insights product that’s early enough for your decisions to define its direction
  • Build on the foundations of the Gather design system and own it across our dashboards and apps
  • Travel to customer sites to observe how people use our products in the field, and bring that context into every design decision
  • Partner closely with mobile and front-end engineering in Pittsburgh and Noida, from MHEV stand-ups and weekly requirements planning through handoffs that remove ambiguity rather than create it
  • Use Claude and other AI tools to move from concept to functioning prototype, and design with an eye to how engineers will use your work with AI to build front ends faster. The team moves fast and expects you to as well
  • Over time, extend your work to internal tools and the occasional piece of marketing material

What You’ll Need

  • Visual craft: a portfolio with strong, simple, modern design that holds up even in data-dense interfaces. We look closely at typography and layout
  • Analytical rigor: you turn data and requirements into clear information hierarchy, and you can show how you knew a design worked, through measures like task time, error rates or training time
  • Experience shipping real products at scale, with users in real workflows, where we can see the thinking behind the screens
  • A desire to be the only designer: you want to own design end to end now, without a larger design team around you
  • Comfort using Claude or other AI tools to build working prototypes, not just static Figma designs
  • Experience designing through user research: you’ve watched people work and changed what you built because of it
  • Figma fluency, or deep experience with a comparable design and prototyping tool
  • The ability to work without a lot of structure: spot what needs designing before you’re asked, and ask good questions when you’re stuck
  • Willingness to travel about 20% of the time (roughly one trip a month) to customer warehouses and our Pittsburgh office

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing interfaces for physical systems such as robotics, drones, industrial machinery or other non-desk environments
  • Founding or sole designer experience, ideally building 0-to-1 at a startup
  • A blend of consumer-grade polish and enterprise analytical depth
  • Experience building or maintaining a design system
  • Background in warehouse, logistics or fulfillment
  • 5 to 10 years of product or UX design experience. Strong candidates with less tenure who have shipped real products at scale are encouraged to apply
  • Experience with generative UI tools beyond Claude, or a software development background

jobs.title: Technical Oversight - Underwriting
jobs.description:
About Pylon

America’s $13T mortgage market is one of the most important financial systems in the world. It underwrites the middle class and is the mechanism through which millions of families build wealth. But while every other financial instrument has been simplified to an API call, mortgages are still assembled by hand.

We started from zero and created the first vertically integrated mortgage platform that turns origination into a single API.

Publicly traded companies and the country’s largest originators are already building on Pylon. Revenue is compounding monthly. We’re backed by Peter Thiel, Conversion Capital, QED, Citi, Fifth Wall, and the founders of Ramp, Blend, and Mercury.

Working at Pylon isn’t for those seeking comfort. The people who thrive here have high agency, strong opinions, and a track record of delivering outcomes without direction. Many of us are former founders. We move quickly, challenge each other directly, and take full ownership of results. It’s hard work, but it will be worth it.

Join us in building America’s mortgage rails.

About The Role

We’re seeking an entrepreneurial Technical Oversight - Underwriting. This role involves both strategic oversight and hands-on management of third party fulfillment providers to ensure efficient, compliant loan origination while enhancing systems and workflows for high-quality, scalable operations.

You will be instrumental in shaping the future of our platform, developing underwriting workflows, standard operating procedures, and quality control measures. You will provide tactical guidance to engineering teams, emphasizing scalable human out of the loop solutions.

We are not a traditional mortgage lender. If you’re excited about building flexible automated systems with rigorous oversight that can scale, this role is for you.

About You

  • Possess expert-level knowledge of the entire mortgage lending process, detailed underwriting knowledge specific to loan requirements and comprehensive understanding of federal, state, and regulatory guidelines related to residential mortgage lending.

  • You are a visionary leader with a clear perspective on building scalable, modular origination infrastructure.

  • Comfortable operating in highly regulated industry whilst optimizing for performance. You build with a compliance first lens, respect regulations, continuously review, and update processes as needed.

  • Obsess over the customer and uphold the highest standard. You build for our customers and their borrowers, doing whatever it takes to make them successful on the platform.

  • Adhere to a scalable software first approach, operational workaround last. You surface issues, lead discussions around long-term solutions, document them, and manage temporary manual workarounds if needed.

  • Ability to oversee numerous 3rd party fulfillment partners, ensuring high quality, on-time originations. You build deep relationships and drive consistent results.

  • Have strong, principled opinions that you’re willing to defend. We have a culture of vigorous discussion and debate on decisions. We’ll push you to articulate your choices, and defend them where necessary.

  • Have great ideas, and lots of them. You should see opportunities all around you to make the product and team better. We’ll provide the environment to act on those ideas.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement underwriting workflows, SOPs, SLAs, checklists, and QC measures to ensure high-quality and efficient loan underwriting.

  • Regularly access and enhance our Underwriting Systems to ensure smooth file flow, high quality, regulatory compliance and efficiency.

  • Oversee day-to-day operations with fulfillment partners, ensuring consistent loan delivery.

  • Define and monitor productivity standards and performance goals and ensure that they are met on a monthly, quarterly and annual basis.

  • Conducting 2nd level reviews, handling exceptions, and managing escalations to ensure quality control.

  • Act as a subject matter expert, aiding decision-making and driving product improvement.

  • Working closely with internal teams, partners, and engineering to drive product improvements and optimize the fulfillment infrastructure.

  • Provide technical and guideline training, recommend areas of improvement, and conduct ongoing training as needed.

  • Maintain a comprehensive understanding of mortgage origination and regulations to ensure compliance.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in underwriting and managing underwriting teams across diverse loan types, including Conventional, Jumbo, NON-QM, GOVT across purchase and refinance.

  • Proven track record in developing underwriting workflows, SOPs, SLAs,and QC measures.

  • Proficiency in configuring Underwriting Systems for efficiency,quality and compliance.

  • Proven track record in managing and leading de-centralized underwriting teams.

  • Experience in the management of strategic 3rd party fulfillment partners.

  • Experience working on mortgage products within a fintech environment is strongly preferred.

Benefits

  • Ownership: Meaningful early-stage equity in Pylon.

  • Healthcare: Top-tier medical, vision & dental with support for dependents.

  • 401(k): Ability to save for your future.

  • Flexible Time Off: Be on when you’re on and off when you’re off.

  • Hardware Allowance: $2,000 to fix up your workspace.

  • Annual Off-sites: Fully paid for team off-sites in beautiful corners of the world.

  • At-cost Mortgages: We’ll help you finance your next home when you’re ready.

jobs.title: Marketing and Commercial Specialist (Canada)
jobs.description:
Not all heroes wear capes — but plenty of them use toilet paper

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business

We make eco-friendly products and donate 50% of our profits to provide clean water and help build toilets for the billions of people who lack proper access. So far, we’ve contributed over $18 million AUD (roughly $12.5 million USD) to fund sanitation projects around the globe. Basically, we’re really good at doing good.

With hubs in Australia, the Philippines, China, the US, UK and Europe, our amazing team of 200+ work to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next couple of years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role

You’ll be the operational co-pilot for our Canadian team as we build Who Gives A Crap into a household brand in Canada. Day to day, that means keeping campaigns moving, keeping commercial pipelines organised and making sure the day-to-day runs smoothly. It isn’t just about updating trackers. It’s about the groundwork that makes sure our brand lands locally and our regional commercial milestones get hit.

If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in

  • Coordinating campaign delivery across social, influencer, PR and events, so cross-functional work lands on schedule
  • Flagging project blockers early and keeping shared timelines and status documentation up to date
  • Being the day-to-day point of contact for our local agencies
  • Coordinating the Canadian social calendar with our global creative team and local agencies
  • Reviewing global and local content to make sure it feels authentically Canadian and on brand
  • Reviewing agency pitches for influencers and giving constructive feedback before they go to the Director for sign-off
  • Keeping the Canadian marketing budget tracker accurate, with zero errors
  • Working through inbound Canadian B2B enquiries, from bulk requests to reorders

Let’s talk about you

You’re a details person who loves a fast-moving team

We’re launching a new market, which means the work moves quickly and the to-do list changes often. You like having lots of moving parts in play and keeping them tidy. You know when to chase a deadline, when to flag a blocker early and when to ask for help.

You have a sharp instinct for what feels right

You notice when copy, an asset or an agency pitch sounds off brand or out of touch with Canadian nuances, and you can say why. You’re keen to suggest local ideas worth testing.

You like to follow the numbers

You’re comfortable in a dashboard. You enjoy spotting what’s working, what isn’t and what to test next, and you’d rather turn a messy report into a clear next step than wait for someone else to do it.

You give a crap

Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence — us too!

Why should you work with us?

First off, as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the highest standards of social and environmental impact. With our most recent score of 125.5 we’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world.

We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right).

Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (95%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn’t be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?

If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger — and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

Note: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Who We Are

We Didn’t Just Rethink PT. We Rebuilt It Around You.

You became a PT to help people—not to sprint through stacked schedules or meet productivity quotas.

That’s why we built Kins: a model that puts you back in control. Here, you treat one patient at a time—for a full hour—so you can deliver the kind of care you were trained to give. You set your schedule. You shape your caseload. And you earn more by focusing on better care, not more visits.

This is physical therapy reimagined—so you can make a real impact, build the career you want, and finally practice on your terms.

In this role

We have a great opportunity to reach more pelvic health patients by offering a virtual only solution to improve access to in-network care for patients. We are looking for physical therapists to treat male pelvic health clients in a remote setting. Virtual pelvic health physical therapy sessions can be conducted from the comfort of your own home or private treatment space.

The perks of being a Kins Physical Therapist

Work when you want:

  • You set your own hours each week (you can include weekends and evenings if you want).

  • No pre-defined shifts — work when you want and for as long as you want!

Competitive pay:

  • We offer highly competitive pay.

  • Get paid per visit — not per unit.

More 1:1 time with highly motivated patients:

  • Our unique model lets you see one patient at a time versus juggling many in a clinical environment.

  • Kins prioritizes convenience with at-home therapy, delivered virtually.

  • Work with a highly motivated patient population that's looking for an individualized physical therapy experience.

Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate, assess progress and provide plan of care and exercise prescription for your patient caseload

  • Provide evidence based, high quality care and guide patients to self-management and successful graduation from care in a value based model

  • Document all treatments and clinical outcome measures in our EMR to routinely assess progress

  • Create a world-class patient experience, communicating via chat and phone with patients and/or providers as needed

  • Able to commit to a minimum of 4 visits/week in a telehealth setting

Requirements:

  • Current Licensed Physical Therapist in Maryland

  • Pelvic Health Level 1 certification with a minimum of 1 year of experience

  • Telehealth experience

  • Completed state-regulated CEU requirement in Maryland

  • Commit to a minimum of 4 visits/week

  • Demonstrated excellent written & verbal communication skills

  • Excited to build and deliver a new model for achieving better clinical outcomes

  • Creative and flexible, but always puts the patient first

  • Excellent at forging successful and respectful relationships with the entire team

Job Type: 1099 independent contractor

Pay: Earn $45 per visit

jobs.title: Strategic Account Executive
jobs.description:
CoderPad's mission is to surface a person's skills in order to form badass teams that create impactful companies.

CoderPad’s Strategic Account Executive oversees account expansion through the engagement of key Talent Acquisition and Engineering stakeholders as a part of our mission to better the technical interview process for everyone.

As the global leader in the technical interview space (3,800+ customers in 165+ countries), it is our Strategic Account Executive’s goal to identify technical hiring challenges and drive the CoderPad value proposition for a book of target accounts.

You’ll report to our Sales Manager and own the sales process from start to finish while also regularly engaging on customer calls.

What you'll be doing:

  • Outbound prospecting (call, email, LinkedIn, etc.) into a triaged list of target accounts and engaging Talent Acquisition/HR and Engineering stakeholders with CoderPad’s value proposition

  • Collaborate with Marketing & Customer Success colleagues to detect new business opportunities with intent-based tools

  • Participate on key client calls with your Customer Success teammates, including quarterly business reviews (QBRs) and renewal discussions

  • Establish a trusted advisor/consultant approach with new prospects and existing customers

  • Suggest new ideas to improve our product, process, and workflows based on customer feedback and strategic approaches

  • Achieve pre-defined outbound activity, pipeline, and revenue targets

  • Engage with a value-based selling approach to delight our customers!

What you should bring:

  • 3 years+ in SaaS sales positions, with at least 2 years as an Account Manager or Account Executive at a B2B tech company

  • Experience focused on expansion opportunities is preferred

  • A hunter mindset, entrepreneurial spirit, and ability to collaborate with internal stakeholders from Marketing, Product, and especially Customer Success to drive a premium customer experience

  • Ability to operate with ambiguity, test and define new ideas, and engage executive buyers with innovative approaches and solutions. One of our values is being bold and this role requires that.

  • A team-player who brings positivity and energy to the team, as well as a strong customer support lens to the account relationships

  • Proficiency in a sales process

  • AI Fluency (and excitement!)

Compensation

Compensation for this role includes: 50/50 base salary and variable + accelerators

Base salary range (in USD): $75,000 - $85,000 with OTE for this role: $145,000 - $165,000

Exact salary is based on skills, experience, location, market ranges, and other compensation offered. The salary range does not include equity and company-wide benefits you may be eligible to receive.

Additional Information

Benefits for You

We are a geographically distributed company. We entrust every team member – personally and professionally. If you enjoy working with a diverse group that truly values team collaboration, we are interested in hearing from you.

While these benefits are specific for full-time US-based employees, qualified candidates from other countries may be considered at CoderPad. All of the benefits below may not apply depending on an employee's country of residence and employment type, though appropriate compensation and benefits will still be offered.

• Medical coverage from day one: CoderPad pays 85-90% of employee premiums (90% on the HDHP plan), plus up to $9,000 in HRA funding on the HDHP plan
• Dental and vision: 100% covered for you, up to 80% for dependents
• Company-funded life, short-term and long-term disability coverage
• 401K with profit sharing. You get the company contribution even if you don't contribute yourself
• Unlimited PTO (we expect at least 3 weeks a year) plus 20 company holidays
• Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (primary) or 12 weeks (secondary) with full pay, benefits and equity vesting
• Remote-first, with a $300 monthly stipend for home office and work expenses
• Wellness perks: Headspace, One Medical and more through Cigna
• Stock options (4-year vesting), competitive salary and growth opportunities

And more…

CoderPad is committed to hiring the best talent. To work at CoderPad, employees must have the permanent and unrestricted right to work in their country of residence without needing present or future sponsorship from the company. If you meet this requirement, all applicants will be considered for employment regardless of race, color, national origin, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, or veteran or disability status. Our goal is to be a diverse team that represents a variety of backgrounds and perspectives and a culture where everyone feels included.

Research has shown that women and people of color are less likely than others to apply for a role if they do not meet 100% of the qualifications. Please know that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel you only are a 75% match. We promote a diverse and inclusive culture at CoderPad.

jobs.title: Hardware Deployment Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Gather AI
Are you ready to build the future of supply chain? At Gather AI, we’re not just creating software; we’re pioneering a new era of warehouse intelligence. We’ve developed a groundbreaking, vision-powered platform that uses autonomous drones and existing equipment to capture real-time data, completely digitizing workflows that have historically been manual and error-prone. This means facilities operate smarter, safer, and more efficiently, ultimately redefining “on-time, in full” delivery.
If you’re looking for an opportunity to contribute to truly transformative technology and make a significant impact in a vital industry, Gather AI is the place for you. We’re leading the charge in the rapidly evolving robotics industry, and we invite you to join us in reshaping the global supply chain, one intelligent warehouse at a time.
About the Team
Gather AI’s Hardware team designs, builds and supports the hardware behind our platform: autonomous inventory drones and camera systems that mount on customers’ material handling equipment (MHE). The team includes hardware engineers and technicians who work out of the Pittsburgh HQ. Hardware designs and builds new product implementations, reviews and repairs RMAs, and performs detailed analysis of field failures while Field Ops runs day-to-day customer site support.
About the role
Our robots are already working in customer warehouses, and every new deployment depends on the right hardware arriving built, configured and ready. In this role, you’ll own the hardware side of that: deployment readiness, field hardware escalations and returns, and accurate documentation of deployment configurations and bill of materials (BOMs) across Hardware programs. This is an ownership role and much of the processes behind it are yours to build collaboratively with Hardware leadership. As our Hardware Deployment & Development Coordinator, you'll be the hardware team's hub between development and field operations: making sure each deployment's hardware is ready on time, owning how we handle field hardware issues and returns, and keeping our bills of materials and fleet configurations accurate across all our hardware programs. You'll report to our Director of Hardware and work closely with engineers, technicians, Field Ops, Purchasing and customer implementation teams.
What you'll do

  • Own hardware readiness for each customer deployment: build schedules, kit lists, parts status, shipping and site prerequisites.
  • Be on site for installs and go-lives as the hardware liaison lead, then hand off cleanly to Field Ops.
  • Own tier-2 hardware escalations: triage, route to the right technician or engineer, and close the loop.
  • Own our RMA process: intake, disposition, failure analysis coordination and trend reporting back to engineering and suppliers.
  • Own BOM accuracy and configuration management across programs, including revision control and serial/config traceability.
  • Build and document the processes behind the work, including the readiness checklist, RMA workflow and configuration control.
  • Plan development builds and test assets with engineering and the technicians, and turn field findings into engineering action.
  • Coordinate development builds, test assets and technician schedules, and turn field findings into engineering action.
  • Give Purchasing a clear demand plan and flag long-lead and single-source risks early.

What you bring

  • You've owned hardware readiness for deployments, production launches or NPI builds end to end —, covering schedules, kits, parts and handoffs — and kept other teams moving toward the date without direct authority.
  • You've owned the record of what hardware is built and implemented: BOMs and revisions, configurations and change control, or RMA processes. Ideally you’ve build one of these, not just owned it.a BOM or configuration record, an inventory system or an RMA process.
  • You can read assembly and part drawings, electrical schematics, and understand critical to quality callouts. drawings and harness pinouts, and you're comfortable getting hands-on to troubleshoot hardware.
  • You can take a field escalation from first report to resolution and keep everyone informed along the way.
  • You're detail-oriented, agile and adaptable and adapt quickly when plans change.

Nice to have

  • Experience in warehouse, material handling or forklift environments.
  • Robotics or autonomous-vehicle deployment experience.
  • Experience working with suppliers or contract manufacturers on ECOs or recurring defects.Experience coordinating with suppliers or contract manufacturers.
  • Experience with Document Control, Good Documentation Practices, and Good Manufacturing Practices.

Location Pittsburgh, PA (on site) or remote in the US. About one week a month on site in Pittsburgh; when a customer deployment is active, travel to that site takes priority. Eastern time zone is a plus.
How we hire A recruiter conversation, a conversation with the hiring manager, a practical deployment-planning exercise, and a final round with the team. We'll tell you before each step whether AI tools are welcome.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Engineers are the reason we exist—they’re the core of who we are. We don’t just build technology; we engineer the future. From next-gen aerospace to cutting-edge defense systems, our teams power the solutions that drive innovation, tackle mission-critical challenges, and keep people safe. This is where problem-solvers and big thinkers thrive.

Quest Defense Systems & Solutions is seeking Senior Embedded Software Engineers to build the foundational software components that enable next-generation avionics systems. This team develops shared libraries, I/O frameworks, and partitioned services that power multiple avionics applications.

This role is ideal for a systems-minded engineer with deep low-level experience who can design robust, certifiable software architectures. This effort will be in support of multiple key programs, including the Next Gen Flight Management System (FMS) program.

Due to the nature of this role, all candidates must be U.S. citizens or U.S. persons.

This role is remote with the possibility of up to 10% travel to Cedar Rapids, IA.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Abstract and consolidate core functions into reusable libraries and frameworks
  • Extract existing functionality from application code and refactor for shared use
  • Design and implement an I/O framework supporting multiple protocols and data interfaces
  • Define and maintain data dictionaries and I/O level specifications
  • Collaborate with system architects to ensure ARINC-653 partitioning integrity
  • Support certification activities through HLR/LLR documentation and DAL compliance
  • Contribute to long-term strategy for scalable, maintainable software infrastructure

Required Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in embedded software development and/or testing.
  • Proven expertise in C++ and object-oriented design for embedded systems
  • Working knowledge of I/O architecture, protocol handling, and data management
  • Background in developing certifiable software (DO-178 DAL A preferred)
  • Proficiency in HLR/LLR generation, review, and traceability
  • Quick learner with strong initiative and drive

Desired Skills:

  • Strong experience with ARINC-653 partitioning and low-level application design
  • Hands-on experience with VxWorks RTOS
  • Familiarity with toolchains and CI/CD environments supporting configuration management and verification (Atlassian Suite, Jama, Coverity, Rapita, etc)
  • Designed and implemented non-volatile data storage systems (e.g., EEPROM, flash, or NVRAM) for configuration or state retention
  • Experience with persistent and transient log storage, including rollover and data retention policies
  • Familiarity with log transport mechanisms (e.g., shared memory, I/O channels, or network-based telemetry)
  • Experience developing or integrating ARINC 661 Cockpit Display Systems (CDS) and User Applications (UA)
  • Familiarity with avionics data buses and communication protocols (e.g., ARINC-429, MIL-STD-1553, AFDX, CAN, SPI, UART, etc)
  • Strategic systems thinker able to plan scalable, reusable frameworks
  • Previous FMS Experience is a bonus but not required.
  • Experience in the adoption and/or integration of emerging technologies (e.g., generative AI, automation platforms, digital assistants) into day-to-day operations for continuous improvement.

Ideal Candidate:

Technically strong software engineer who can balance deep systems knowledge with strategic foresight. One who understands how to design reusable building blocks for complex, safety-critical systems—and thrives in a fast-moving environment where architecture, certification, and execution come together.

jobs.description:
Shape the future of innovation as we tackle cutting-edge projects that make a difference. We’re not just in the business of engineering—we’re building a brighter future. Driven by creativity and a culture of excellence, we believe in the power of engineering to solve today’s challenges and create opportunities for tomorrow. What we do matters.

Quest Defense Systems & Solutions is looking for a Lead Nuclear Digital Instrumentation & Controls (I&C) IV&V Engineer to provide technical leadership for verifying and validating complex digital control systems used in the nuclear industry.

This is an engineering role—not simply a test execution position. You will determine what needs to be verified, how to test it, and what evidence is needed to demonstrate compliance. You'll work across software, hardware, firmware, FPGA, systems engineering, quality, and project teams to evaluate system performance, identify technical risks, and ensure requirements are fully verified.

Location: Wilmington, NC initially, transitioning to Nampa, ID after approximately six months. Candidates may relocate or travel approximately 50%.

This position supports a project that will be performed in two phases:

  • Initial phase: For approximately the first six months, the engineer will support onsite work in Wilmington, NC. Candidates may be based in or temporarily relocate to the Wilmington area or travel onsite approximately 50% of the time, generally in one- to two-week blocks.
  • Second phase: After the Wilmington phase, the project will transition to Nampa, ID for the remainder of the assignment. The engineer must be willing to relocate to the Boise–Nampa area or continue traveling onsite approximately 50% of the time.

  • Work closely with systems, software, hardware, FPGA, quality, manufacturing, suppliers, customers, and project management teams.

  • Experience developing and executing verification and validation (V&V) strategies for complex systems.
  • Experience developing test plans, test procedures, test reports, and requirements traceability.
  • Strong understanding of configuration management and requirements-based testing.
  • Strong judgment in verification strategy and objective evidence
  • Experience with software development in a safety-critical environment (DO-178, ISO 26262).

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer - Multicore Platforms & Avionics Networking
jobs.description:
We don’t just build technology—we engineer the future. From next-gen aerospace to cutting-edge defense systems, we tackle the toughest, mission-critical challenges that keep people safe and push the limits of innovation. This is where problem-solvers, innovators, and big thinkers thrive.

Quest Defense Systems & Solutions is seeking an Embedded Software Engineer with experience developing low-level software for multicore processors and System-on-Chip platforms. This role requires hands-on experience with deterministic avionics networking—particularly Time-Sensitive Networking, ARINC 664 Part 7/AFDX, or related ARINC communication standards—as well as development within a DO-178 environment. You will work at the intersection of software and hardware, developing processor-level software, enabling new hardware platforms, and integrating multicore systems with FPGA, ASIC, and other custom hardware.

Location: Remote candidates will be considered provided they are available for an initial onboarding period in Endicott, NY and can travel to the site on a quarterly basis thereafter.

Citizenship: U.S. citizenship is required

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain low-level embedded software using C, C++, and Assembly.
  • Develop software for multicore processors and SoCs, including processor initialization, inter-core communication, synchronization, shared-resource management, and deterministic execution.
  • Develop and integrate deterministic avionics networking solutions using TSN, ARINC 664 Part 7/AFDX, PCIe, and related real-time communication technologies.
  • Develop board support packages, boot code, device drivers, and other platform-level software.
  • Support new hardware bring-up, board initialization, and hardware/software integration.
  • Integrate embedded software with FPGA, ASIC, and custom hardware components.
  • Develop software in accordance with DO-178B/C processes and applicable safety-critical requirements.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot timing, latency, concurrency, and real-time performance issues.
  • Debug processor- and board-level software using hardware debuggers, trace tools, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and related laboratory equipment.
  • Develop Python-based tools to support debugging, testing, automation, and integration.
  • Collaborate with software, hardware, FPGA, ASIC, systems, and verification engineers throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Participate in software architecture, design reviews, testing, technical documentation, and continuous process improvement.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or another relevant STEM discipline.
  • 4+ years of embedded software or firmware development experience in aerospace, avionics, defense, or another safety- or mission-critical environment.
  • Strong programming experience with embedded C and C++.
  • Experience developing very low-level, real-time embedded software, such as BSPs, boot code, device drivers, processor initialization, or platform software.
  • Hands-on experience developing software for multicore processors or multicore SoCs.
  • Experience with deterministic avionics networking or communications, including at least one of the following:
    • Time-Sensitive Networking
    • ARINC 664 Part 7 or AFDX
    • Related ARINC avionics communication standards
  • Experience working within a DO-178B/C software development lifecycle.
  • Experience with board bring-up, hardware initialization, or hardware/software integration.
  • Experience interfacing embedded software with FPGA, ASIC, or other custom hardware.
  • Experience debugging embedded systems using hardware debugging or trace tools.
  • U.S. citizenship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with ARM processor architecture and ARM-based SoCs.
  • Experience with PCIe or other high-speed hardware interfaces.
  • Experience with RTOS, bare-metal, or embedded Linux development.
  • Experience analyzing timing, latency, concurrency, WCET, or deterministic system performance.
  • Experience with ARM Development Studio, DSTREAM, or comparable processor-debugging tools.
  • Experience using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other laboratory equipment.
  • Experience developing Python scripts for debugging, testing, or workflow automation.
  • Familiarity with DO-254 and hardware/software design assurance activities.
  • Active security clearance or the ability to obtain one.

The QDSS Advantage

At QDSS, you’ll work alongside collaborative engineering teams on complex, mission-critical programs where software reliability and technical precision matter. You’ll have opportunities to deepen your expertise, take on new challenges, and contribute to platforms with meaningful real-world impact.

What You’ll Find Here

  • Work That Matters: Contribute to next-generation safety- and mission-critical systems.
  • Supported Growth: Competitive compensation, employer-matched 401(k), certification assistance, and opportunities for advancement.
  • A Collaborative Culture: Join a flexible, people-focused environment where teamwork, technical excellence, and work-life balance are valued.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, comprehensive medical, dental, life, and disability coverage, a 401(k) with employer match, professional development support, and a flexible, collaborative workplace.

Full compensation package is based on candidate experience and certifications

Pay Ranges

$100,000—$140,000 USD

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer, Detection & Response
jobs.description:
For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well.

For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you.

Angi at a glance:

  • Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021

  • Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide

  • Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting

About the team:

At Angi, security is woven into everything we build, from PCI-scoped payment flows to the AI agents now handling homeowner/pro conversations and scheduling end-to-end. Detection signal spans cloud, endpoint, identity, SaaS, and a growing set of autonomous agents. You'll own detection and response as an engineering problem: build the detections, build the automation that works them, and carry the pager for what still gets through.

While this is a remote position, we are a global company and are looking for applicants located in eastern or central time zones to align with our team's working hours.

What you’ll do:

  • Build and own detections across AWS (GuardDuty, CloudTrail, SecurityHub), EDR, identity, SaaS, and our AI gateway. Coverage, precision, and latency are properties we manage across a rule's lifecycle.

  • Own the security log pipeline, and own it as a product with consumers: audit and security logs land centrally and are exposed to the teams that need them for triage, analysis, and incident response.

  • Own detection on the application protection layer - account takeover, credential stuffing, and abuse patterns against a two-sided marketplace.

  • Build the triage layer - enrichment, correlation, containment, evidence capture - working toward a median alert that resolves without a human touching it. Use LLM and agentic tooling where it earns its place, and own the verification layer that makes that output trustworthy.

  • Buy the tool where a tool is right, build where it isn't, and extend where it's close. You'll ship code in a repo, not only configure consoles.

  • Extend detection coverage to Angi's agentic AI products: what anomalous behavior looks like for an autonomous agent holding calendar and account access - prompt injection attempts, tool-call abuse, data exfiltration through the agent surface.

  • Actively participate in all facets of the incident response lifecycle by participating in a 24/7 on-call rotation.

  • Own the technical controls InfoSec retains for detection within compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS (tamper-detection monitoring, log integrity, alerting coverage).

  • Partner with platform and product teams so new services ship with telemetry, threat models, and response playbooks. You will be in the room when these are designed, not brought in after the fact.

Who you are:

  • You have 5+ years of experience working on a security team supporting product/engineering functions, cloud infrastructure, and corporate infrastructure development

  • You have software engineering experience (Python preferred) and an engineering mindset for building reliable / maintainable security infrastructure to support a large organization with CI/CD software engineering practices

  • You are at home in the analytics and observability stack detections get measured on - Grafana, Looker, NewRelic or similar. You will build your own coverage and precision dashboards rather than filing a ticket for them.

  • Hands-on with AWS and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent); working knowledge of EDR, SIEM, and SOAR platforms and their APIs.

  • Hands-on with containers and Kubernetes, including what detection and forensics look like on that surface.

  • Sound build-versus-buy judgment with no allergy to either answer. You reach for what exists when it fits, and you're comfortable wrapping, extending, or replacing it when it doesn't.

  • You've owned incidents end to end - page, diagnosis, fix, postmortem.

  • Some level of exposure to LLM/agentic system security (prompt injection, agent identity, data exfiltration via AI systems).

  • A daily, fluent user of AI-assisted coding/security tools. You are able to speak concretely about how you direct and verify AI output.

  • Strong written communication: you'll write detection documentation, postmortems, and design feedback that other engineers rely on.

  • Comfort executing the technical side of a compliance framework (PCI, SOX, or similar) is preferred.

Compensation & Benefits

  • The base salary band for this position ranges from $150,000 - $225,000, commensurate with experience and performance. Compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location.

  • This position will be eligible for a competitive year end performance bonus & equity package.

  • Full medical, dental, vision package to fit your needs.

  • Flexible vacation policy; work hard and take time when you need it.

  • Pet discount plans & retirement plan with company match (401K).

  • The rare opportunity to work with sharp, motivated teammates solving some of the most unique challenges and changing the world.

We value diversity

We know that the best ideas come from teams where diverse points of view uncover new solutions to hard problems. We welcome and value individuals who bring diverse life experiences, educational backgrounds, cultures, and work experiences.

Our hiring process may utilize artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision-making.

jobs.title: Global Payroll Lead
jobs.description:
About the job:
Hi, I’m Atlee and I’m the Controller at Ashby. We're hiring a Global Payroll Lead to own payroll for our fast-growing, global employee base. We pay employees across an ever-growing number of U.S. states and internationally, through a mix of local entities and employers of record (EOR). Every pay cycle has more people, more jurisdictions and more complexity than the one before.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You’ll be the company’s payroll expert and the person accountable for getting it right. You’ll run the day-to-day work yourself and also design how payroll should run as we scale. We’re looking for someone who stands out in customer service, analytical horsepower, attention to detail, independent time management and speed.

Payroll is a critical part of both the employee experience and business operations. You’ll own the full payroll cycle (semi-monthly and monthly) across all of our populations. That covers the details behind it: employee data changes, leave events, bonuses, commissions, deductions, off-cycle payments and final pay. It also covers the controls, vendors and processes that hold it all together. You’ll partner closely with Finance, People Operations, Benefits, Legal, managers, employees and external providers so that payroll is right the first time, and when it isn’t, issues get resolved quickly and the root cause gets fixed.

What you’ll do

  • Own recurring payroll activities across U.S., U.K., Canadian, and international EOR/contractor populations, coordinating timelines, inputs, approvals, processing, and final review.

  • Collect, validate, and enter payroll changes, including new hires, terminations, compensation changes, promotions, bonuses, commissions, deductions, reimbursements, leave, and return-to-work events.

  • Review payroll registers and supporting reports for accuracy, reconcile discrepancies, and coordinate corrections, off-cycle payments, and retroactive adjustments.

  • Partner with Finance on payroll funding, payroll accounting, reporting, reconciliations, and month-end or year-end close activities.

  • Coordinate with payroll, tax, benefits, HR, and EOR vendors to resolve issues, manage escalations, and maintain exceptional service levels.

  • Support payroll tax filings, notices, audits, year-end reporting, and other compliance activities in partnership with internal stakeholders and external providers.

  • Serve as a trusted point of contact for employee payroll questions, explaining complex issues clearly and following through to resolution.

  • Build and maintain payroll calendars, checklists, standard operating procedures, and control points that make payroll more predictable and scalable.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual work, strengthen controls, and improve the connection between payroll, People systems, benefits, and Finance.

  • Support projects related to payroll infrastructure, global expansion, system changes, and process improvements.

What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years of experience in payroll operations or payroll administration

  • Direct experience supporting payroll for employees in multiple countries, including U.S. and Canadian payroll and/or international EOR or contractor populations.

  • Experience in payroll for both exempt and non-exempt employee populations.

  • Experience managing payroll inputs, validating payroll registers, reconciling results, and processing corrections or off-cycle payments.

  • Working knowledge of payroll compliance, tax concepts, wage and hour requirements, leave-related pay, and year-end processes.

  • Strong attention to detail and a consistent record of accurate execution against firm deadlines.

  • Comfort working across multiple systems and vendors, with the ability to trace an issue back to its source and determine the right fix.

  • Strong spreadsheet and analytical skills, including the ability to audit data and explain variances.

  • Excellent judgment and discretion when handling compensation, tax, banking, and other sensitive employee information.

  • Clear, thoughtful communication with employees, managers, Finance, People, and external partners.

  • A proactive, process-oriented approach: you notice recurring problems, document what you learn, and improve the system rather than relying on workarounds.

  • Ability to work independently in a distributed, asynchronous environment while keeping stakeholders informed.

You should apply if

  • You are the person others trust to catch the detail that could otherwise become a payroll problem.

  • You have experience with payroll platforms such as Gusto, Deel, Remote, or similar systems.

  • You can balance precision and urgency without losing sight of the employee experience.

  • You have operated in an environment where the process is growing and not every answer is already documented (and you’re the one who is excited to document!)

  • You communicate early when something is unclear, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and follow through until the issue is closed.

Interview Process

Our interview process is thorough - we assess if you are the right fit for Ashby and we will provide ample information for you to determine if Ashby is the right place for you. The process for this role is as follows:

  • Recruiter Screen with Talent Acquisition- 30 min

  • Hiring Manager Interview with Atlee - 45 min

  • Practical Assessment

  • Final Round - 2.5 hours, consisting of four 30 minute interviews with key stakeholders

Benefits

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby, do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅.

  • Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

  • 401(k) with a 3% employer contribution, regardless of your contribution.

  • If you’re in the US, top-notch health insurance for you and your dependents with all premiums covered by us.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business

We make eco-friendly products and donate 50% of our profits to provide clean water and help build toilets for the billions of people who lack proper access. So far, we’ve contributed over $18 million AUD (roughly $12.5 million USD) to fund sanitation projects around the globe. Basically, we’re really good at doing good.

With hubs in Australia, the Philippines, China, the US, UK and Europe, our amazing team of 200+ work to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next couple of years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role

This is a 6-month, fixed-term role supporting payroll for our Philippines hub. You’ll work closely with business leaders and our Payroll Lead to check PH payroll invoices, resolve any discrepancies, and collate everything into one clean file ready for review each pay cycle. It’s a finance-side role — think careful admin and attention to detail in Excel or Google Sheets, not managing a payroll system.

If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in

  • Checked payroll invoices for the PH hub with business leaders to confirm hours and amounts were accurate.
  • Collated the month’s invoices into a single file ready for the Payroll Lead’s review.
  • Chased up a business leader for a missing invoice ahead of the payroll deadline.
  • Updated the PH payroll tracker to reflect the latest pay cycle.

Let’s talk about you

You’ve got payroll in your bones (at least 5 years of it)

You’ve spent 5+ years in payroll, ideally on the finance side rather than the HR side, and you know your way around invoices, pay cycles and the occasional discrepancy that needs chasing down.

Excel (or Sheets) is basically your happy place

You don’t need to have used a fancy payroll system before — what you do need is to be genuinely comfortable building and maintaining accurate files in Excel or Google Sheets, because that’s how this role runs.

You’re organised, detail-obsessed and easy to work with

You like things tidy, you catch the small errors before they become big ones, and you’re comfortable chasing business leaders for the odd missing invoice without losing your cool.

You give a crap

Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence — us too!

Why should you work with us?

First off, as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the highest standards of social and environmental impact. With our most recent score of 125.5 we’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world.

We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right).

Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (95%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn’t be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?

If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger — and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

jobs.title: Field Intelligence Analyst (Tokyo)
jobs.description:
About Sayari:

Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv.

About the Role

Sayari’s customers buy answers to hard problems: who really owns a supplier, where a sanctioned network is moving goods, which alerts deserve an analyst’s time. Sayari’s AI platform Superconductor delivers those answers at machine scale. It is built in the field, with analysts and engineers working alongside customers to define what it needs to do.

The Field Intelligence Analyst brings Sayari’s tradecraft to that work. You scope the problem, design the solution, prove its value, and deliver mission impact. You own the analytical relationship for a portfolio of accounts, from first conversation through sustained delivery. What you learn on live engagements flows back into Superconductor and into Sayari’s tradecraft standard.

You work in our Field Intelligence Department, a global team of analysts deployed to support government agencies and Fortune 500 companies. You sit in the same org as Forward Deployed Engineers and the Product team. The field shapes the roadmap, and Product sets it.

Why This Role Exists

  • Customers buy answers. Superconductor reasons like an expert analyst at machine scale. The analyst’s job shifts from producing every answer by hand to directing, validating, and extending what Superconductor produces, and teaching customer analysts to do the same.
  • Context should survive the contract. The analyst who designed the proof-of-value knows why the success criteria are what they are. Keeping that analyst on the account protects delivery quality and surfaces the next problem before the customer names it.
  • Tradecraft is built in the field. Field Intelligence Analysts see what was promised, what was delivered, and what the customer did with it. That full view produces better methodology, better evals, and a better Superconductor than any single-phase role can.

What You Will Do

Own the analytical relationship, end to end

  • Run discovery and proof-of-value engagements anchored on work the customer already pays people to do, such as alert adjudication, due diligence, investigations, and case prioritization. Define success criteria you will personally be accountable for delivering.
  • Stay on the account after close and deliver the work you scoped. This includes multi-hop investigations across ownership, trade, and corporate records, plus analytical briefings and training.
  • Serve as the customer’s single analytical point of contact from first conversation through renewal.

Build with Field Engineering and Product

  • Pair with FDEs on discovery and delivery. You define the analytical requirement, they build it, and you validate it against the mission.
  • When something built for one customer should be rebuilt for many, make the case to Product with evidence: the problem, the workaround, and the customers who share it.
  • Document where the platform falls short of the mission, with raw examples attached.

Deliver analyst-plus-AI, and teach it

  • Direct Superconductor against live mission problems. Validate its reasoning against expert standards, and extend it into new customer workflows.
  • Train and certify customer analysts on Sayari methods and on working with Superconductor. Identify the customer experts who should go further.

Build the tradecraft

  • Capture the judgment calls, non-obvious pivots, and creative approaches from live engagements. Contribute them to the Tradecraft team as expert-annotated reference cases, eval scenarios, and training material.
  • Hold your work to the Field Intelligence standard, and help raise it.

Support Go-To-Market Teams

  • Work with Sales to diagnose customer problems, scope solutions, and deliver mission impact.

Who You Are

Required

  • A builder’s temperament and comfort with ambiguity. You do well on small teams with end-to-end ownership and no defined lane, working next to engineers on things that don’t exist yet.
  • Experience conducting complex, multi-source investigations in one or more of these areas: financial crime, sanctions and export controls, supply chain and forced labor risk, transnational criminal organizations, or law enforcement and intelligence investigations. This should include work with corporate records, trade data, and OSINT.
  • Customer-facing range. You have scoped engagements, demonstrated capability to skeptical experts, and delivered under a statement of work. Candidates often come from solutions consulting, services delivery, embedded analytics, or mission-support roles.
  • Hands-on fluency directing and evaluating AI and agentic analytical tools. You can define what “right” looks like precisely enough to test against.
  • Clear communication with analysts, program managers, engineers, and executives.

Desired

  • Python or SQL for data manipulation, and familiarity with REST APIs.
  • Experience designing training curricula or certifying analysts.
  • For government portfolios: an active Government security clearance and same citizenship as your country of residence.

Compensation

The target base salary for this position is ¥7,800,000 to ¥11,900,000 in Japan, plus variable bonus and equity. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, candidate experience-levels and expertise, internal peer equity, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Benefits:

  • 100% fully paid medical, vision, and dental for employees and their dependents
  • Generous time off; we observe all US federal holidays, close our office for a winter break (12/24-12/31), in addition to granting 18 PTO days and 10 sick days
  • Outstanding compensation package; competitive commissions for revenue roles and bonuses for non-revenue positions
  • A strong commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion
  • Eligibility to participate in additional benefits such as 401k match up to 5%, 100% paid life insurance (up to $100,000 coverage), and parental leave
  • A collaborative and positive culture - your team will be as smart and driven as you
  • Limitless growth and learning opportunities

Sayari is an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourages diverse candidates to apply. We believe diversity and inclusion mean our team members should reflect the diversity of the United States. No employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ethnicity, religion, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability status, veteran status, genetics, or political affiliation. We strongly encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply.

Pay Range

¥7,800,000—¥11,900,000 JPY

jobs.title: Senior Sales Associate, API (L3)
jobs.description:
CoinGecko is a global leader in tracking cryptocurrency data. Operating since 2014, CoinGecko has built the world's largest cryptocurrency data platform, tracking over 10,000 tokens across more than 400 exchanges, serving over 300 million page views in more than 100 countries, and handling more than 45 billion API calls every month. We are proud to have played a major part in mainstream awareness, adoption, and education of cryptocurrency globally.

We at CoinGecko believe that cryptocurrency and blockchain will define the future of finance, bringing greater financial and economic freedom around the world. In anticipation of that future, CoinGecko is building the foundation to scale cryptocurrency market data to serve billions.

Compensation

Additional Information

jobs.title: Clinical Trial Coordinator (Coordinator, Rater Services)
jobs.description:
At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

That’s why we’re seeking a Coordinator, Rater Services responsible for supporting multiple operational activities and functional areas to ensure the successful delivery of Cogstate's Rater Services programs and clinical trial support activities. The Coordinator, Rater Services will provide flexible, cross-functional support across a variety of service areas and serve as a key point of coordination between internal teams, study stakeholders, and external customers.

As workloads naturally fluctuate throughout the lifecycle of clinical trials and departmental initiatives, the Coordinator, Rater Services will be cross-trained across multiple operational functions and will work collaboratively with different teams, stepping in where support is needed most. Functional areas may include:

  • Rater Training

  • Central Rating
  • Scale Management

The Coordinator, Rater Services is responsible for maintaining accurate documentation, supporting operational reporting, coordinating communications, and delivering exceptional customer service to sites, clinicians, raters, CRAs, sponsors, institutions, and internal stakeholders. The role also contributes to quality management and operational oversight by ensuring processes and deliverables are completed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with established standards.

What’s In It For You

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager, Singapore
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find, fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by IT Ops/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers & operators, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools and false positives, resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

What You’ll Do

We are seeking a high-impact, results-driven Field & Channel Marketing Manager to lead integrated marketing execution in Singapore.

This is a highly visible manager-level role designed to accelerate pipeline growth through a balanced mix of field marketing, channel partner marketing, demand generation, executive engagement, and regional go-to-market execution.

The successful candidate will build and execute scalable regional programs that strengthen partner relationships, create demand, support sales priorities, and elevate brand presence across key markets. This role will be supporting both Enterprise and Commercial Sales reps.

Regional Growth Strategy & Execution

  • Own and execute the integrated marketing plan for Singapore, aligned to APJ revenue priorities and sales targets.

  • Translate corporate campaigns into localized regional programs that drive measurable pipeline and partner engagement.

  • Develop multi-touch programs including, but not limited to, events, webinars, direct mailers, roundtables, digital, social and ABM.

  • Support regional sales teams with campaign strategy, market insights, and program execution.

  • Build and execute partner marketing plans with strategic resellers, distributors, MSSPs, alliances, and channel ecosystem partners.

  • Drive MDF / co-marketing investment toward measurable pipeline outcomes.

  • In partnership with the channel team, launch partner-led demand generation campaigns, enablement programs, and joint market initiatives.

  • Strengthen relationships with channel sales leaders and partner account teams.

  • Manage lead flow, nurture alignment, conversion optimization, and follow-up processes with SDR and sales teams.

  • Monitor campaign performance and continuously optimize based on ROI, conversion, and pipeline metrics.

  • Build quarterly business reviews and performance updates for leadership.

  • Share best practices across APJ and contribute to scalable regional programs.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experienced marketing to Singapore and the general Asia Pacific region

  • Strong experience across field marketing + channel/partner marketing + demand generation.

  • Proven success supporting revenue teams and delivering measurable pipeline growth.

  • Experience working with indirect routes to market including VARs, distributors, alliances, and service providers.

  • Strong commercial acumen and ability to prioritise investment by market opportunity.

  • Comfortable operating in matrixed, fast-growth environments.

  • Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Experience in using technologies such as SDFC, Asana, Reachdesk, G-Suite, Zoom Info, ON24.

What Sets You Apart

  • Understanding of cybersecurity categories such as cloud security, endpoint, identity, SOC, threat intelligence, zero trust, or managed security.

  • Experience with ABM strategy and enterprise account engagement.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

  • Depending on experience, the compensation range for this position is: SGD 120,000 - 160,000. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, 25 vacation days, and generous parental leave.

You Belong Here
