Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Global Project Management, Lab Services
jobs.description:
Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO. At Precision for Medicine we have brought together new technologies, expertise and operational scale to help the life sciences improve the speed, cost and success rate of bringing life-changing therapies to patients. What sets us apart is the way we integrate clinical trial execution with deep scientific knowledge, laboratory expertise and advanced data sciences.

Due to our continued growth, we are seeking a Project Manager, Global Project Management, Lab Services.

Position Summary:

This role will lead new and existing CRO laboratory projects across a range of disciplines all with the focus on accelerating the development and adoption of novel therapeutics. This includes assay development and clinical testing, biorepository/sample management and logistics, and kitting for client studies spanning the globe. This is a key role which is client-facing, ensuring project plans are translated into action and results, requiring internal cross-functional leadership.

Leads and manages all aspects of designated protocols and is accountable for overall project performance and client satisfaction by meeting their needs and expectations throughout the lifecycle of assigned projects. Provides internal consulting on project management issues and identifies opportunities for process and efficiency improvement. Serves as the cross-functional lead for assigned projects and monitors operational delivery progress against contracted timelines and budget. Prepares and maintains process documents and mentors junior Project Managers.

Essential Information:

  • Leads projects from conception through close-out, ensuring detailed planning and execution, risk management, communication and stakeholder management, scope and cost control
  • Works on problems of moderate scope where analysis of situations and/or data requires a review of a variety of factors
  • Navigates ambiguity and has a system and process solution mindset to support growth and continuous improvement
  • Developing professional expertise, applies company policies and procedures to resolve a variety of issues
  • Contacts are both internal to the company and external with client/vendor on routine matters
  • Builds productive internal/external working relationships
  • Normally receives general instructions on routine work, detailed instructions on new projects or assignments
  • Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

  • Excellent listening and communication skills, has an uncanny ability to make internal colleagues and clients feel understood
  • Create and manage project timelines, budgets and revenue goals, forecasting, resource plans, while comparing to contracted project scope(s), fully exploring new ideas that optimize quality and efficiency
  • Maintain detailed daily coordination and supervision of scheduled activities, delegating responsibilities to carry out contracted work activities, as appropriate
  • As the face of the company and key partner to clients and collaborators, effectively lead implementation of new and ongoing studies
  • Coordinate the development and implementation of new projects
  • Create, track, and report on project timelines
  • Communicate with clients and collaborators with regards to data management, inventory control, shipping procedures, for all assigned areas
  • Respond in a timely manner to all events
  • Coordinate data gathering
  • Prepare and present project information at internal and external meetings; prepare reports and correspondences to clients, collaborators, and vendors
  • Meet all revenue objectives assigned to projects, project expenses, and client billi Evaluate contract/project budgets monthly and report unexpected variances to department director
  • Create/track/report relevant metrics for business and project measurement
  • Assist senior staff, as required
  • Identify out of scope project work; escalate findings and action plans to appropriate parties
  • Manage all tasks in an efficient and timely manner, ensuring client expectations are met and are delighted
  • Review, update, and evolve all documentation associated with project(s) to approvable status
  • Assess and mitigate technical, project, and business risks
  • Ensure that work product complies with design and performance standards, regulatory environment and client expectations. Enforce standards applicable to each step in project execution
  • Identify, resolve, and assist in resolution of operational issues
  • Monitors assignments and adjusts priorities and work schedule to meet deadlines and provide high quality deliverables. Completes additional tasks needed in support of project, client and departmental objectives
  • Complete other responsibilities, as assigned

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in a life science or related field plus a minimum of 5 years of project management experience in biotechnology, clinical trials, central lab, repository, or pharmaceutical industry; in some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the rol

Other Required:

  • Excellent computer skills and experience with MS Office/MS 365 applications
  • Proven track record of coordination and communication with team members across disparate technical and business backgrounds such as R&D, Operations, Finance, Business Development, Sales, Manufacturing, Executive Management, Quality Assurance, and Regulatory Affairs; ability to lead and drive stakeholder discussions
  • Excellent presentation, interpersonal, organizational, and multi-tasking skills; skilled emotional intelligence
  • Able to work in front of a computer for long hours at a time
  • Strong understanding of project management and data analysis
  • Strong critical thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Exceptional use of judgment and discretion
  • Able to read, write, and fluently speak and comprehend the English language
  • Proven track record of being a team player, willing to interact proactively and productively
  • Must possess a valid driver's license; must be able to travel both domestically and internationally, including overnight stays (~10-25%)
  • Extended work hours may be necessary in order to meet business demands

Preferred:

  • Familiarity with GCLP, GLP, GMP, CLIA, and ISO regulatory guidelines
  • Familiarity with Smartsheet or other Project Management tools

We invite you to learn more about our growing organization serving our clients that are researching ground breaking cancer therapies. jobs.title: Sales Development - Japan
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

As a Sales Development (SDR) based in Japan, at ElevenLabs you will play a crucial role in building an effective outbound sales strategy, whilst working closely with the Account Executives.

We don’t just sell a product or custom-level solutions; we are partnering with enterprises to help them generate new experiences and monetisation opportunities at scale with our breakthrough voice technology.

In this role you will

  • Conduct research to identify potential leads and prospects within the target market.

  • Engage in outbound activities such as cold calling, emailing, and social media outreach to initiate contact with potential customers

  • Implement personalized and effective outreach campaigns to maximize lead conversion.

  • Collaborate closely with the Account Executive to exchange insights on prospect feedback, objections, and market trends.

  • Continuously refine and adjust outreach strategies based on the feedback loop.

  • Monitor and report key performance indicators (KPIs) related to outbound sales activities, including conversion rates, lead quality, and outreach effectiveness.

  • Collaborate with the sales leadership to analyze data and optimize strategies for better results.

Requirements

  • 2-3 years outbound B2B sales experience with a track record of securing new business meetings.

  • Demonstrated ability to build Opportunity sized lead lists in new markets and categories

  • Experience with full suite of prospecting tools

  • Demonstrated ability to build, scale process

  • Demonstrated ability to nurture a team

  • Curiosity - asking insightful questions and developing solutions from a foundation of knowledge and insight.

  • Self-motivated, thriving as part of a team while possessing the ability to stay driven and proactive independently.

  • Effective time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage a high volume of leads.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Japanese

Location

This role is remote-first, however there is a preference for candidates to be based in Tokyo with the option to work out of one of our offices.

#LI-remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Copywriter (Performance) - 12 month contract
jobs.description:
Not all heroes wear capes — but plenty of them use toilet paper

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business

We are a leading eco-friendly household essentials business and we donate 50% of our profits to help everyone gain access to clean water and a toilet. As of June 2026, we’ve contributed over $20 million AUD to this mission. Basically, we’re really good at making it easy to do good.

We operate scaling businesses the UK, US, Australia and Canada. Our 250+ people aim to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next 5-10 years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role

We’re a purpose-driven brand with big goals. We don’t just want to succeed – we want to make the world a better place while we do it. But here’s the challenge: we need someone who can craft compelling content that not only drives performance and boosts conversions, but also stays true to our brand and our humanity. It’s a true writer’s challenge, and we need you to help us hit it out of the park. If you’re a performance copywriter who believes in the power of words to create both impact and results, we’d love you to join our team.

Reporting to the Senior Copywriter, you’ll collaborate closely with our creative team to create paid video campaigns, SEO-focussed blog posts and search-optimised Meta content that fuels both our growth and our social impact. From concepting and scripting videos with our talented video team to crafting copy that aligns with our brand and performance objectives, your words will help drive both visibility and results. Plus, your SEO-driven blog posts will help boost rankings and extend our reach.

This role is fully remote based in our Australian hub and is a 12-month fixed term contract.

If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in

  • Worked closely with the video team to develop a fresh concept and script for our Meta videos, featuring a playful showdown between our co-founders as they debate their favourite Who Gives A Crap product, optimised for conversion and engagement.
  • Crafted a cheeky blog post that reveals what it means if you scrunch or fold your toilet paper, designed to grab attention and spark conversation.
  • Brainstormed ways we can make our impact messaging more resonant and sticky.
  • Worked with the Digital Product team on elevating our site experience with A/B testing.
  • Written a direct mail insert to encourage people to share our brand with friends.
  • Joined our monthly Creative Pin Ups and helped celebrate the team’s work.
  • Brainstormed and shared inspiration in the monthly Copy team meeting.
  • Joined one of our Creative Team squads to help contribute to the culture of the team.

Let’s talk about you

Performance copywriting is your bread and butter

You’ve honed your performance copywriting skills, excelling at crafting scripts and supporting copy for paid video ads across multiple channels. SEO and social media ad platform experience are essential, but we’re happy to help you build expertise if you have a hunger for learning. Conceptual experience isn’t a must – what’s important is your grasp of our tone of voice and how it comes to life beyond the page. You tailor content for each platform, making sure it’s engaging, on brand and optimised for performance, blending creativity with data-driven insights to drive results.

You’re curious and strategically aware

You ask insightful questions and make sure your work is aligned with marketing strategies and broader business goals. You’ve consistently applied performance marketing best practice across various channels, and you stay up to date with trends and principles so your copy drives results.

You’re self-aware and collaborative

You build strong, positive relationships with your manager, the creative team and cross-functional partners. You know how to work in highly collaborative environments and you’re good at balancing e-commerce goals with tone of voice and creative excellence. Your self-awareness and ability to adapt to different perspectives keep you aligned with business objectives while making teamwork feel seamless.

You’re a time management guru

You thrive in fast-paced environments and manage your time efficiently. With multiple channels to track and new work constantly coming in, you excel under pressure, meeting deadlines and prioritising key tasks. You proactively flag challenges to your manager or project manager, keeping the workflow smooth and the team on track. Your ability to juggle competing priorities is crucial to driving our business objectives and performance goals.

You give a crap. Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence — us too!

Why should you work with us?

First off, as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the high standards of social and environmental impact. We’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world.

We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right).

Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (over 90%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn’t be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?

If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger — and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, Release Marketer
jobs.description:
Hi 👋 I’m Rosalia, and I look after our Product Marketing team at Ashby.

I started my career in Product Marketing and helped build the Sales Enablement function at HubSpot during its journey from startup to IPO. Since then, I’ve worked across RevOps and Customer Marketing at Procore and Meta, partnering with incredible teams to bring differentiated products to market. I first heard of Ashby through our Head of Content, Anum with whom I’d spent those early days at HubSpot, and was inspired by the level of thoughtfulness and operating principles I saw and read about. I joined Ashby in April of 2024 back in Product Marketing - bringing all these experiences together to help build a thoughtful, high-impact team.

We’re a growing, tight-knit team - and we’re just getting started 🚀 We work closely with Product, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and every level of leadership, including closely with our CEO Benji. We’re seen as strategic partners, not a service desk. PMM at Ashby means influence, visibility, and ownership - and this role is a chance to get in early on a team with strong internal momentum at a company growing fast.

We value technical curiosity, editorial clarity, and first-principles thinking. We avoid jargon, favor plain English, and aim to genuinely help customers understand what our product does and how it can help them. You don’t need a decade in PMM to succeed here - but you do need strong product instincts, clear writing, and a bias for building systems that scale.

We’re looking for a Release Marketer who is excited about owning product releases.

This role is for someone who thrives on the details but understands the bigger picture – someone who can clearly explain how a new feature or product benefits prospects and customers in their daily workflows and approach to talent acquisition. Someone who wants to work closely with Product and Engineering to understand how a feature works, and act as a translator for the front-line teams. That means translating product specs into the materials, messaging, and demos that power our releases. This person should feel excited about selling with value and obsess over customer use cases and how we tell our product story. From crafting one-pagers and recording crisp, clear product videos and walkthroughs, to running our product updates newsletter, to building internal enablement that keeps our whole team informed on what’s changed, you’ll help us tell our differentiated story and keep our launch velocity high.

You’ll work across multiple product lines, so you’ll need to context switch easily. Organization, attention to detail, and the ability to juggle and coordinate across multiple teams are among the most important skills for this role. On any given week, you’ll be keeping several releases moving, each with its own Product Manager.

Because we’ve built deep relationships with a thoughtful, engaged customer base, we’re often co-creating with them - sharing product materials that are actually read, used, and appreciated by people who see us as partners, not just vendors.

This is a great fit for someone who enjoys being in the weeds of technical products, but also has a sharp editorial voice, a strong eye for design, strong product instincts, and loves to always be shipping.

While this role will flex across multiple products, you’ll have the opportunity to grow into eventually owning a full product line. This role is also a great opportunity for someone who wants to flex across PMM and enablement skills, and work on product marketing initiatives that create more leverage for our teams.

Your Background

There is not a single background that is the perfect fit for this role. We care more about the skills and intrinsic capabilities you bring to the table, and could see someone from a number of different backgrounds being a good fit, including:

  • A Solutions Engineer who loves narrative and wants to shape more than just demos

  • An Early-stage AE who worked closely with Product

  • A Product-minded builder with a technical background and customer empathy

  • A GTM specialist with a strong lean for product taste

What You’ll Do

Release Products and Features

  • Own go-to-market planning and execution for feature releases across multiple product lines.

  • Work closely with Product Managers to shape value propositions, messaging, and demo strategies.

  • Produce polished feature videos for use across social media, the website, and other marketing channels.

  • Create assets including blog posts, one-pagers, demo videos, internal launch docs, and enablement materials.

  • Turn features into clear customer value through videos, product walkthroughs, and content that make the benefit obvious.

  • Partner with other product marketers on larger and bundled launches where support is needed.

Keep the release engine moving and create leverage for your team

  • Serve as a product expert and go-to resource for how features work and how we position to the market.

  • Coordinate release promotion with Solutions Engineering, RevOps, Sales, CS & Support teams to ensure audiences across the organization are best-equipped through their channels.

  • Own initiatives that keep the whole team informed on product changes, including our product updates newsletter to customers.

  • Help maintain our product launch velocity by leveraging AI, automation, and building scalable systems to manage a high volume of releases, giving yourself time back for more high-leverage work.

You Might Be a Fit If You

  • You’re highly organized, and can keep multiple releases, owners, and deadlines moving at once without anything slipping.

  • You’ve got an exceptional eye for detail - people consistently trust you as the final eye on something because you catch more than just typos every time.

  • You can switch between products and contexts easily, and pick up a new feature quickly enough to explain it well.

  • You’re the person people ping and say, “Can you just explain this feature in normal words?” and you actually can.

  • You know how to shape a good demo or walkthrough that tells a story. Not just “click here, then here” but “here’s how this solves your problem.”

  • You are comfortable owning your own copy and collaborating with design teams to produce well-polished assets.

  • You can read a launch plan and immediately hear the voices of Sales and CS in your head “but what about XYZ?”, and you’ve already worked with technical and product teams for the answer.

  • You can follow a playbook but are not afraid to go back to first principles thinking and build something from scratch without much direction.

You Might Not Be a Fit If:

  • You’re drained by the strive for perfection. If a letter is out of place or a font is off by a size point, it won’t bother you.

  • You’re not a natural relationship builder and don’t feel comfortable working across Product and GTM folks.

  • You aren’t the person people go to when they’re trying to understand the complexities of a new product.

  • You find stakeholder and project management more draining than satisfying.

  • You’d rather not weigh in on or be the final call on creative because someone else will catch it (noting you will have design support, but that someone to catch it is you :)

Interview Plan:

  • 30 min with Michelle (Recruiting)

  • 45 min Rosalia (Hiring Manager)

  • 30 min with Harriet (VP of Marketing)

  • Assignment

  • 30 min with Benji (CEO and Co-founder)

  • Final Round Interview (1-1.5 hours)

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity.

  • 10-year stock option exercise window. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO with a strong culture of actually taking time off.

  • 12 weeks of fully paid family leave (US).

  • Generous budget for equipment, software, and office setup. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • $100/month learning budget, with conferences covered with manager approval.

  • Top-tier health insurance for US employees (100% premium covered).

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

jobs.title: Growth Marketer, SEO/AEO and Experimentation
jobs.description:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

Role Overview:

Search is changing. Enterprise buyers now ask ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews which Customer Experience AI platforms to evaluate, often before they ever visit a vendor’s website. Your job is to make sure Cresta shows up in those answers, shows up accurately, and turns that visibility into pipeline.

You’ll join Cresta’s Growth Marketing team, reporting to the Senior Manager, Growth Marketing and working alongside our Content Marketing Manager on a small team that treats organic search and AI discovery as a core pipeline channel.

You will own day-to-day execution of Cresta’s Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and SEO program. Roughly 70 to 80 percent of your time goes to scaling organic search and AI visibility. The rest goes to growth experiments on new acquisition channels and conversion levers.

This is a high-ownership, hands-on role. You will run the systems that make Cresta’s organic engine work: the AI content workflows, the technical foundation, the measurement, and the testing roadmap. The Content Marketing Manager leads writing; you own how that content gets found, cited, and converted. You will also work with web development, product marketing, demand generation, and revenue operations, and report results straight to marketing leadership.

What you'll do

AEO and organic search

  • Grow Cresta's visibility, citation share, and narrative accuracy across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews through content structure, schema, entity consistency, and third-party mentions.
  • Own our AirOps workflows for content briefs, refreshes, and optimization, and keep improving them so a small team ships more without lowering the bar.
  • Run the content refresh pipeline: spot decaying pages in Google Search Console and Ahrefs, diagnose the cause, and partner with the Content Marketing Manager to brief and ship fixes.
  • Restructure high-impression pages for AI answers: answer-first sections, self-contained answer passages, FAQ and list schema, and clear relationships between products, use cases, and industries.
  • Lead technical SEO across crawlability, indexation, rendering, internal linking, redirects, canonicalization, and site architecture. Work directly in our Webflow CMS to ship fixes, and partner with web development on larger changes.
  • Build an off-site presence program across review platforms, analyst and industry directories, third-party roundups, partner pages, and communities where answer engines source their information.
  • Make sure every product launch and rename gets organic coverage from day one, working with product marketing on URLs, redirects, schema, and answer content.
  • Turn questions from sales calls, support conversations, community threads, and search data into a prioritized answer backlog written in the buyer's own language.

Growth experimentation

  • Design, launch, and read out experiments on emerging acquisition channels, such as community and Reddit, and on landing page and website conversion from organic traffic.
  • Write a hypothesis and success metric before every test launches, then make a clear call to scale it or kill it.

Measurement and reporting

  • Own measurement across non-branded visibility, organic and AI-referred traffic, AI citations and share of voice, and influenced pipeline.
  • Build dashboards that catch ranking drops, indexing issues, crawl anomalies, and technical regressions before they cost us traffic.
  • Connect search and answer engine visibility to pipeline in HubSpot, and keep measured data and modeled estimates clearly separated.
  • Stay ahead of changes in search and AI discovery, and turn them into a clear point of view and a prioritized roadmap.

What success looks like

  • First 90 days: You own the content refresh pipeline and AirOps workflows end to end, have shipped your first round of answer-first page rebuilds, and run a recurring AI visibility report that leadership reads.
  • First 6 months: You run the AEO testing roadmap independently, have launched at least two growth experiments outside organic search, and can show which pages and channels are driving pipeline.
  • First 12 months: You are the go-to person for how Cresta shows up in AI answers, and the program you run is a repeatable, measurable growth channel.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements below. If you do, please apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. If you are coming from an adjacent team and have been teaching yourself AEO on the side, we want to hear from you.

Minimum requirements

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in SEO, growth marketing, or other organic growth roles, with hands-on ownership of a live website.
  • A track record of growing organic traffic and pipeline or signups, not just rankings.
  • Hands-on experience with AEO or GEO, including how AI assistants retrieve, summarize, and cite content, plus at least one project or test you can walk us through, including self-directed ones.
  • Technical SEO fluency and comfort shipping changes yourself: HTML basics, schema markup, and working inside a CMS.
  • Hands-on experience with Google Search Console, Ahrefs or Semrush, and GA4, plus an AI visibility tool such as Ahrefs Brand Radar or Profound.
  • Experience defining metrics, building dashboards, and using data to prioritize work, including reconciling conflicting sources and forming your own conclusion.
  • Clear, precise writing. You can write a brief a writer can execute without a follow-up meeting, and an answer passage an LLM can quote.
  • A high bar for quality and full ownership from idea through implementation and measurement.

Preferred qualifications

  • In-house SEO or growth experience at a B2B SaaS company with an enterprise sales motion or a technically complex product.
  • Experience with AirOps or building content workflows with LLMs like Claude or ChatGPT.
  • Experience with Webflow, HubSpot, or multi-touch attribution.
  • Experience with crawl and log analysis tools, programmatic pages, or scaled content operations.
  • SQL or Python skills for pulling and analyzing data on your own.
  • Experience running conversion rate or community channel experiments, including Reddit.
  • Exposure to customer experience, customer support, or contact center operations.

Perks & Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family
  • Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child
  • Retirement savings plan to help you plan for the future
  • Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office
  • Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced
  • In-office meal program and commuter benefits provided for onsite employees

Compensation at Cresta:

Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

Compensation for this position includes a Base Salary + Equity.

Base Salary Range: $100,000 - $165,000.

Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. Your recruiter can provide further details. In addition, total compensation includes a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.

We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Cresta employee, reach out to recruiting@cresta.ai

Our use of AI in recruiting: We may use AI tools in our recruiting process, which require human review and oversight. If you have questions about our use of AI or wish to opt out, please contact recruiting@cresta.ai (if you are opting out, please use the subject ‘Opt-Out’ in your email).

Recording & AI transcription: We do not authorize candidates to record or use AI transcription of any interview by phone, notetaker app, AI glasses, or other device. Candidates may request an exception or accommodation for review during the interview process as needed.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

At Panopto, we are the most customer-centric learning technology company in the world. As the leader in visual and audio-based learning, we empower organizations to share knowledge effortlessly in a capture and post-capture world. We don’t just build software; we obsess over our users’ goals to deliver solutions that truly matter. Our mission is simple: to attract the brightest talent, people like you, to Elevate the Craft and do the most impactful work of your career.

To enhance our team we are seeking a motivated Sales Development professional to join our Sales Development Representative, Americas team here at Panopto and make a visible difference for our business.

Position Summary

In this role, you will have the opportunity to do meaningful work in your career, elevating your craft while contributing to a team that values lifelong learning.

As a Sales Development Representative, you own everything to do with generating new qualified leads for our sales pipeline: strategy, planning, and execution. You will own specific activity targets for qualifying potential customers from both inbound (they contact us) and outbound (we contact them) initiatives. In addition to activity targets, you will explore and recommend creative outbound sales campaigns to drive qualified pipeline.

You'll also have opportunities to contribute to other initiatives that directly advance our core values and support you in elevating your craft.

How You’ll Contribute

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Build Pipeline & Outreach: Source new sales opportunities through inbound lead follow-up, outbound cold calls, emails, and LinkedIn messaging.

  • Prospecting & Discovery: Perform effective discovery and qualification calls with prospects. Attend in-person trade shows and exhibitions to represent Panopto.

  • Lead Qualification: Research target accounts, identify key decision-makers (particularly C-Level, VP, and Director personas across HR and IT departments), and generate interest to maintain and expand your database within your assigned territory.

  • Team Collaboration: Route qualified opportunities to the appropriate Account Executives for further development and closure, assisting and partnering with them to bring new customers on board.

  • Technology: Master how the Panopto platform is used by our customers to effectively qualify prospects based on their specific needs and requirements.

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 3 Months: Complete onboarding, gain deep fluency in the Panopto platform and value proposition, master internal sales tools (Salesforce, Outreach, Lusha/ZoomInfo), and comfortably begin executing daily inbound and outbound prospecting activities.

  • Within 6 Months: Consistently meet or exceed monthly and quarterly activity and qualified lead targets, effectively run discovery calls with key HR/IT stakeholders, and forge strong cross-functional partnerships with regional Account Executives.

  • Within 1 Year: Serve as a reliable engine for regional pipeline growth, contribute novel outbound messaging campaigns, over-achieve quota targets, and begin developing core sales leadership skills for career progression within Panopto.

  • Your Legacy: Establish scalable demand generation frameworks in your territory that expand Panopto's reach and set the benchmark for sales development excellence.

Values in Action

  • Customer First, Always: You proactively surface friction points in the customer experience before they are escalated — and propose solutions, not just reports.

  • Thrive Together: You share work-in-progress for early feedback, knowing that challenge improves the outcome. You separate critiques of ideas from critiques of people.

  • Elevate the Craft: You hold the bar high on your own work and invest in developing those around you. You treat every project as an opportunity to learn something new.

  • Act with Ownership: You define success by outcomes, not activity. You flag problems early and bring a proposed path forward, not just the problem.

  • Clarity Over Complexity: You default to the simpler solution. Your written communication — internal or external — is direct, specific, and free of filler.

How We Thrive

You’ll join a globally diverse team that thrives on clarity, ownership, and continuous improvement.

We operate with a bias toward action—balancing strategic thinking with execution—and hold ourselves accountable to outcomes that drive the business forward. The Sales Development team works in close partnership with Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Marketing leaders in a tight-knit culture to ensure an exceptional journey for leads from initial outreach to becoming long-term customers. Collaboration is at the core of how we work, and we value diverse perspectives that strengthen our collective thinking.

The Foundation for Success

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

  • Experience: 1–2 years of experience working in a sales role (any industry) OR completion of a sales/customer-facing internship (preferably in SaaS/Tech or fundraising).

  • Core Sales Competencies: Proven inside sales/sales development experience converting prospects and a track record of meeting/over-achieving targets. Solid experience in opportunity qualification, pre-call planning, and confident phone control.

  • Tools & Systems: Hands-on experience working with Salesforce (or similar CRM), Outreach, and lead enrichment tools (e.g., Lusha, ZoomInfo).

  • Professional Skills: Ability to stay organized, multi-task, prioritize, and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.

What Sets You Apart

  • Industry Focus: Previous experience in B2B tech/SaaS sales.

  • Persona Experience: Prior success qualifying opportunities involving multi-stakeholder decisions with C-Level, VP, and Director personas in HR and IT.

  • Productivity Tools: High proficiency with web presentation tools and corporate productivity suites.

Join Us

Join Panopto and be part of an exciting journey where your passion for working in a collaborative environment will make a significant impact on our growth trajectory. We're looking for people with excellent communication and listening skills, a genuine interest in what we do, and a fantastic attitude when faced with business challenges.

Compensation

Total Rewards: The salary range for this position is $45,000 - $50,000 USD per year. This position is also eligible for commission earnings per the Sales Commissions Plan with an on-target-earnings of $76,923 USD as part of the compensation package.

Base pay offered may vary depending on various factors, including, but not limited to: job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other eligibility factors such as geographic location. The Total Rewards package includes competitive base pay and an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs such as health insurance, flexible spending accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. At Panopto, we know that great people make an organization great. We value our people and offer employees benefits that are market competitive for our industry. Learn more about what working at Panopto can mean for you.

At Panopto, our commitment to pay equity and transparency is unwavering. We do not engage in salary negotiations beyond the established range to maintain fairness and prevent potential pay disparities among team members based on negotiation strategies.

Additional Information

Beyond the Requirements: At this point, we hope you're feeling excited about the job description you’re reading. Even if you don't feel that you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We're eager to meet people that believe in our mission and can contribute to our team in a variety of ways - not just candidates who check all the boxes. We want people to feel comfortable expressing their true selves and to come, stay, and do their best work here.

Recruiting Tips: From crafting an impressive resume to presenting your best self during our interviews, we're dedicated to ensuring you feel well-prepared and self-assured as you embark on opportunities at Panopto. Discover some valuable Recruiting Tips from our team.

The standard interview process at Panopto involves several steps, outlined below, to ensure we approach the process thoughtfully and consistently:

Application Review -> Recruiter Call -> Video Interview & Assessment -> Hiring Manager Call -> Interview Loop -> Debrief -> Offer

Our people and culture

Panopto’s mission is to be the leader in visual and audio-based learning in a capture and post-capture world. Our user base is as diverse as the world’s universities and businesses. Panopto’s commitment to fostering a fair, equitable, and inclusive culture empowers each member of our team to express their authentic selves, contribute their distinct perspectives and make a meaningful impact both individually and collectively. This inclusive environment not only encourages creativity and the free exchange of ideas but also harnesses the power of varied viewpoints. As a result, we are better equipped to tackle our most intricate challenges, leveraging the wealth of different experiences and backgrounds within our team. This collaborative spirit empowers us to challenge ideas (not people) recognizing that our shared success relies on collective wisdom. It drives us to continuously improve and innovate, ultimately elevating the quality of our products and services. It’s what sets Panopto apart as a unique and rewarding place to work.

Our purpose

We believe that video can have a transformative effect on learning. So we built a video knowledge management platform that helps businesses and universities improve the way that they train, teach, and share knowledge. Since 2007, we have been a pioneer in video capture software, video management, and inside-video-search technology. Panopto has been adopted by more than 1,600 companies and universities worldwide with over 11 million end users. Today, Panopto’s knowledge management platform is the largest repository of expert learning videos in the world. A proud remote-first company, Panopto is headquartered in Pittsburgh, with offices in London, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Sydney, and has received industry recognition for its innovation, rapid growth, and company culture.

Panopto is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified individuals which will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected criteria, in accordance with applicable law. Panopto is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities. If you require accommodation for interviewing or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please provide more detail on how we can further support you by reaching out to the Employee Experience department.

Remote, US: Candidates looking for flexible or remote-friendly positions are encouraged to apply. Panopto is proud to be a remote-first company. Employees in this position are eligible to work remotely.

Remote, International: Candidates looking for flexible or remote-friendly positions are encouraged to apply. Panopto is proud to be a remote-first company. Employees in this position are eligible to work remotely. Still, they may make regular trips to the local international office from time to time, where applicable.

Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI)

Panopto AI Use Policy:

Panopto’s AI Use Policy is committed to a hiring process that is thoughtful, fair, and centered on human connection. As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes more prevalent in the workplace, we believe that it is important to describe our use of AI in the hiring process, as well as outline to candidates what use of AI is and is not allowed. While AI can be a valuable tool, it cannot replace genuine human interaction or an individual’s unique perspective, experience, and voice.

Company Use of AI:

Panopto may utilize tools to enhance the efficiency, objectivity, and quality of our recruitment and evaluation process. These tools assist our team throughout the hiring lifecycle by focusing on four key areas:

  • Content Creation: Providing a starting point for crafting job descriptions and assisting in building tailored interview questions.

  • Resume Parsing: Analyzing candidate skillsets and resume alignment to efficiently identify qualified candidates.

  • Interview & Assessment Insights: Providing interview transcription, summarization, and identifying key insights from candidate assessments in relation to specific role requirements.

  • Data Organization: Organizing and storing information gathered during assessments to help our team make informed, data-driven decisions.

Ultimately, these tools are used to support—not replace—our team in assessing skills, generating insights, and identifying the best talent for Panopto.

To ensure fairness and transparency:

Human-Centric Decisions: Please be assured that AI tools are used to support our team, and all final hiring decisions are made by human reviewers. Panopto hiring teams will thoroughly review your application and assessment results. AI is not used to make final decisions regarding your candidacy.

Bias Mitigation: We are committed to algorithmic fairness. Our AI-assisted tools undergo regular independent audits to detect and mitigate bias, with the goal of keeping our processes equitable and inclusive. Our methodology aligns with global best practices and regional digital ethics standards to provide every candidate with a fair and merit-based evaluation.

Your Rights & Accommodations: We provide inclusive access for all applicants. If you require a reasonable adjustment due to a disability, or if you prefer a non-automated review of your application, please contact Panopto Talent Attraction. We respect your right to request human intervention; please note that opting for a manual review may impact the standard processing timeline.

Data Privacy and Security:

Your personal data and recordings are processed securely in compliance with global privacy and employment regulations (including EEOC, GDPR, and other local or regional privacy laws, as applicable).

To facilitate our recruitment and evaluation process, limited candidate data may be shared securely with trusted third-party vendors and service providers acting on our behalf. We retain candidate data only as long as necessary to fulfill the recruitment purpose or as required by applicable statutory retention periods. Once this purpose is met, or the retention period expires, your data is securely deleted or anonymized in accordance with our data governance policy.

Panopto is dedicated to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates.

Use of AI:

Statement of Transparency:

At Panopto, we embrace the transformative power of AI to enhance productivity and learning. We believe in providing a level playing field where candidates can use modern tools to put their best foot forward, provided those tools support, rather than replace, their authentic voice and expertise. While we encourage the use of AI as a tool for growth and preparation, we require transparency and authenticity to ensure a fair evaluation for all.

Acceptable Use:

  • AI-Assisted Preparation: You are encouraged to use Generative AI (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini) as a mock interviewer or coach to refine your speaking points.

  • Research & Knowledge Gathering: Using AI to synthesize industry trends or company background is permitted and viewed as proactive preparation.

  • Career Guidance Tools: Simulation tools that help you practice the STAR method or identify skill gaps are acceptable.

Prohibited Use:

  • Live Interview Assistance: The use of real-time AI "teleprompters," live answer-generators, or deepfake audio/video during Panopto recordings or live sessions is strictly prohibited.

  • Plagiarized Work Samples: Any take-home assignments or portfolios must be your original work. While AI can assist in formatting or brainstorming, the core logic and execution must be yours.

Panopto has a zero-tolerance policy toward the misrepresentation of job-related skills. Consequences of using prohibited tools may result in my immediate disqualification from the hiring process, the withdrawal of any pending offer, or termination of employment if discovered after hire.

Verification of Experience:

To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and validate the skills demonstrated during your Panopto submission, Panopto may require the following "Proof of Experience":

  • Work Samples & Portfolios: Candidates may be asked to provide original work samples (e.g., code repositories, design portfolios, case studies) that pre-date the current application.

  • Digital Footprint & Professional Links: We may request links to professional profiles (e.g., LinkedIn, GitHub, Behance) to verify career trajectory and industry contributions.

Disclosures:

  • Live Validation: Any technical skill demonstrated in an asynchronous Panopto recording is subject to a live, "Human-in-the-Loop" technical assessment or deep-dive discussion.

  • Fraud Detection: Please be aware that we utilize metadata analysis and fraud detection tools to ensure the authenticity of all video submissions.

By submitting your application and participating in the recruitment process, you acknowledge and consent to Panopto's use of AI, as well as the acceptable and prohibited uses of AI as a candidate, as described above.

Panopto is dedicated to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates.

jobs.title: Head of Mid Market Sales, Americas
jobs.description:
About Ashby

Sales at Ashby is a unique opportunity to sell a product customers genuinely love during an AI-fueled market expansion. Over 5,000 companies rely on Ashby including Shopify, Snowflake, OpenAI, Bolt, and Notion, and our business is durably growing faster than 100% year-over-year. We’re well funded, and on a path to profitability. That's exceptionally rare for a company at our scale, and puts us in the top 10% of benchmarks.

We have, in just a few years, replaced incumbents Greenhouse and Lever more than 500 times each, clear evidence of strong product-market fit and a meaningful opportunity to help modern teams move beyond legacy recruiting software. Ashby replaces 3-5 tools in a consolidation & efficiency play that’s equally loved by recruiters and CFOs. We’re known as a clear AI-leader in the recruiting space.

And the market opportunity is growing. We are rapidly extending from a best-in-class recruiting product toward a multi-product platform, expanding upmarket, into new industries, and internationally. For sales reps, that means a large market full of legacy tools, and a product portfolio that creates room for both new business and expansion. This is a chance to participate in how a category-defining company wins in its next phase of growth.

We are equally intentional about how we build the business. We have established a remote-first, high-performing sales organization that rewards learning and accountability. We use data to set achievable quotas, and reward sustained impact with competitive compensation and meaningful upside. We prioritize coaching and career development, with AEs advancing to Enterprise & Leadership roles in just a few years — 38% of the team who have been here more than a year have been promoted or taken on a new role!

You will work with people who care about craft, customer outcomes, and winning together—without sacrificing the trust, autonomy, and balance required to do your best work over the long term. Don’t just take my word for it, see what the team has to say about working here.

About this Role

To scale Ashby into the hundreds of millions of ARR, we are seeking a senior B2B SaaS sales leader to lead our high performing Mid-Market sales team in AMER. The start date of this role will be Q1. This is currently a second-line leadership role, initially overseeing a team of three managers growing to four in Q2. This strategic leadership role reports directly to our Head of AMER Sales (Leigh Brown). There are three primary responsibilities that this senior sales leader will take on:

  1. Build an Amazing Team. Hire, lead, coach, and develop the North American sales team including Managers and Account Executives.

  2. Execute on the Sales Plan. Be accountable for the region’s revenue and results. Foster programs that ensure high-caliber execution across all segments.

  3. Unlock new Opportunities. Partner with peers in Revenue Operations and Marketing, to expand Ashby’s Serviceable Addressable Market to clear a path to $200M+ in ARR in 2027 through a focus on new verticals and products.

You will have a significant impact in defining our go-to-market strategies to help us achieve our ambitious growth plans. You can read more about our Sales Team here.

If we are even moderately successful, we'll have an incredible growth story to tell in just a few years!

You could be a great fit if:

  • 💼 You’ve been a second line sales leader at a $100M+ high growth SaaS company

  • 🥇 You have a proven track record of hiring high performing Managers and AEs who quickly move the needle. You’re also comfortable making timely performance management decisions.

  • 📊 You have managed a Mid-Market sales-led go-to-market motion (100-1000 FTE).

  • 📈You are well versed in modern pipeline generation practices and programs that ensure sustainable pipeline coverage for substantial YoY growth.

  • 🤝 You’re an expert collaborator who builds relationships internally and can drive change initiatives forward to improve overall operations.

  • 🤓 You connect the dots quickly. You can evaluate the health of the business, and hone in on the most impactful areas to drive performance and bend the growth curve. Your team trusts you to provide practical advice and consultation to navigate challenging or complex issues

  • ⚙️ You are adept at developing sales strategies for multi-product platforms and competitive rip-and-replace deals

You shouldn't apply if:

  • You haven’t managed managers at a high growth SaaS business

  • Your primary focus is the forecast and extracting information from your direct reports. At Ashby, your job is to bend the curve, not just report the numbers.

Our Philosophy

Here are a few key points that should give you an idea of what it is like to be a Sales Leader at Ashby:

  • We're highly collaborative and we believe in a team-based sales motion to maximize our win rates on high impact deals

  • We believe in developing subject matter expertise (not just on our product but also the talent acquisition space broadly) which allows us to provide a differentiated buyer experience

  • We continue to make material investments in engineering and product because we know at the end of the day, having the best products makes winning new customers easier

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over decades of experience, and thoughtful & clear communication both internally and with customers. Please read more about our operating principles here.

Interview Process

Our interview process is designed so you can showcase your achievements and points of learning and apply those to a practical exercise. We'll provide you with sample customer calls and pipeline data so you can develop a well informed perspective on our product and the Mid Market segment. You’ll have opportunities to ask questions of our team throughout.

The interview process for this role is four rounds in the following order:

  1. Intro Call (30 min) - You'll meet with Steph Fish, our TA Manager for Sales, to discuss your fit for the role and address questions about our market and solution

  2. Experience Deep Dive (1 hr) - You'll walk Leigh through your leadership experience in some detail to highlight your achievements, and points of learning.

  3. Panel Presentation (1 hr) - We'll provide you with Ashby data and seek your perspective on the business and focus areas. You'll discuss your approach to leadership, hiring and developing managers and sales execution.

  4. Final Round (2.5 hrs) - You'll have a set of four interviews with a range of cross-functional leaders

Benefits

  • You’ll get the time to do things the right way; we put a lot of emphasis on high quality work and avoid quick hacks as much as possible.

  • You get to sell a product that our prospects & customers are truly excited about.

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅

  • Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.
